He then asks a Geckle next to him if he knows of a way out, but the Geckle simply replies with a dismissive no before a skeleton, overhearing their conversation, whips the air between the both of them.

Later on, he once again attempts to speak to the Munce and Geckle he saw earlier, however both refuse to speak to him and insult each other, prompting other members of both species to join the argument, with Cole questioning why the two hate each other so much before they are all called off to glop time, in which, although confused, he follows.

When being given glop, he looks at it in discuss, but leaves when the skeleton tells him to. He goes to sit by Murt, asking if there are any other Munce he can speak to who are smarter, however, Murt replies proudly that he is smartest, although mentioning a few other names afterwards. Cole, confused, asked if all Munce names started with M, to which Murt called him ''Mole'', claiming that they did. Cole is baffled by this and attempts to correct him, but Murt remains stubborn and continues to refer to him as Mole, prompting confusion from Cole.

The ninja arrive, plotting a plan to rescue him. As he feeds a Mino some glop, the ninja come and free him, with him expressing relief at the sight of them. Together, they free the Geckles and the Munce, but Cole warns them of the Skull Sorcerer. However, when they try to leave, the Geckles and the Munce break out into another fight, causing the mines to descend into chaos and alerting the Skull Sorcerer to the Ninja's presence, and he quickly captures them and puts them to work.

The Two Blades[]

Cole and the other ninja are put to work by the Re-Awakened, forced to mine heaping amounts of Vengestone, which explains their inability to use their powers.

After causing a ruckus, they are locked up in a cage with several Geckles. When Gliff picks a fight with Murt, the ninja start wondering where their feud started.

Gliff explains that long ago, a hero named "Gilly" (who the Munce argues was named "Milly,") entered the mountain with two blades to defend the Geckles and Munce from a terrible dragon known as Grief-Bringer (who the Munce argues was called "Mief-Bringer.") After defeating the dragon, "Gilly" left behind her blades as gifts to the Geckles and Munce — leaving the Ivory Blade of Deliverance to the Geckles, and the Shadow Blade of Deliverance to the Munce.

The two tribe's feud started when the Munce apparently stole their blade, however, the Munce argues that the Geckles were the ones that stole the blade. The ninja come to the conclusion that it was actually the Skull Sorcerer who stole both blades, in order to get control over both tribes. While the tribes fight over themselves, they can't fight the Skull Sorcerer.

Lloyd puts together a plan to get the two tribes to make a truce so they can all break out. Word is passed around through Geckles and Munce about a secret meeting after lunch, and when the time comes, they discuss retrieving both Blades by defeating the Skull Sorcerer.

Later, the ninja break out of their cages by getting a Minos to eat through their chains. The ninja split up, while Cole and Lloyd attempt to find the two blades, Zane and the others go about releasing the remaining Geckles and Munce. A few minutes later, chaos ensues, as Cole and Lloyd are chased away by the Skull Sorcerer.

In the commotion, the ninja are split up so that Jay, Nya, and Lloyd go one path, while Zane and Kai go down another. Cole is further separated from the group as he is chased by the Skull Sorcerer.

The Skull Sorcerer[]

Cole finds himself hangs off a branch with a deep abyss below. Cole tries to come up with a plan and spots a skeleton holding a hook. Without notice, the branch breaks, but Cole is able to hang onto the skeleton's legs. He then lassoes the hook onto a rock, but the skeleton breaks as well. Cole tries to climb using the hook and rope, but the rock also breaks. Luckily, he hangs onto a cliff and screams for help.

Suddenly, he encounters Dire Bats and one of them picks Cole up. The other one tries to clasp Cole, but it results in Cole falling until a third Dire Bat takes him and begins flying away from the group. While being chased, Cole uses his Earth Punch to slow down the other Dire Bats. He then is able to break free from the Dire Bat who had Cole and runs to a cave. Unexpectedly, the Dire Bat retreats and Cole brags on how superior his abilities are, but he runs into a sticky situation.

An enormous spider comes down from their web and tries to eat Cole. At first, Cole is able to hold up until the spider shoots webs at Cole's hand, and eventually his entire body. Facing certain doom, Vania and Chompy appear out of nowhere to fight the spider. Chompy tries to give aid, but the spider simply swipes the small dragon aside. Vania then hurls her spear at the spider, but the spider deflects it. Vania gets frustrated at the spider, and unknowing to Vania, Chompy turns into a gigantic dragon, so the spider flees. Cole tells Vania about Chompy, but Vania thinks it a joke.

Wu, Vania, Cole, and Chompy interrupt Vangelis to tell him everything they witness. Cole comments about the Skull Sorcerer and the Skull of Hazza D'ur, but Vangelis reveals the skull. Suddenly, he transforms into the Skull Sorcerer which shocks everyone.

Vangelis throws the Skull of Hazza D'ur to Cole and Wu. He then presses a button causing Cole and Wu to fall into a pit. Vania goes after them despite Vangelis telling Vania she would no longer be his daughter.

The Real Fall[]

While Cole is screaming and falling, he spots Wu who is above him. Cole shouts to Wu, but Wu cannot hear him. Cole then screams even louder to see if Wu is alright and Wu says he's okay for the moment. Cole then tells Wu to accelerate so he can hear Wu, but Wu tells Cole to slow down his fall. Cole doesn't know how to slow down the fall, and all he gets from Wu is to flap his arms, but Wu yawps for Cole to use his Elemental Powers. Cole flaps his arms anyways, but it proves to be useless.

Wu then hears Vania from above. She hollers at Wu to slow down his fall by flapping his arms, but it doesn't work. Cole then recognizes some vines, so he grabs onto a couple, but his momentum causes the vines to break. Realizing it doesn't work, he is able to grab Wu's hand and they wait for Vania. She is able to get into their range, and she tells them to grab onto her as he uses the wings; however, they break, and all three fall.

The spider takes Cole and wraps him in webs. Another spider decides to join and fights for Cole. While both are fighting, the one holding Cole drops him, but a third spider takes Cole. Vania is able to break free and distracts the spider by throwing objects at the spider which causes it to drop Cole. The spider then goes after Vania, so she finds some weapons to fight. She throws a spear at the spider, but it continues to head for Vania. She then climbs onto a ledge and when given the chance, she jumps onto the spider and gives Wu a spear to free Cole. However, the three are surrounded by the three spiders, so Cole decides to cut the web causing them to fall.

Cole, Wu, and Vania starting sliding down the caves before landing in a stream. They try to hang onto rocks but continue to drift. They then find what they thought was another rock, but it turns out to be a water monster. They continue down the stream before encountering a whirlpool. Wu tells Cole to use his powers to break a stalactite, but Cole doesn't know how. Wu tells Cole to concentrate and after a bit of difficulty, he causes the stalactite to break off the cave and stop the whirlpool.

The three climb on top of the stalactite tired and exhausted. Suddenly, the stalactite breaks, and they are sucked into the whirlpool and are spat out to a small lake. Cole drags Wu and Vania out of the water, observes, and lies down. That's when Fungus approaches him and introduces himself. The other members including Plundar, Korgran, and Adam greet Cole, but he faints. What they don't realize is they are at Rock-Bottom.

Dungeon Party![]

Cole wakes up in fear after seeing Adam in front of him. The Lowly introduce themselves and call themselves adventures, but when Cole asks them to go on another quest, they become quiet. Cole asks about the lack of self-confidence, so Korgran explains their story.

After hearing everything, Cole proclaims they will escape Rock-Bottom and calls them the Upply.

Dungeon Crawl![]

In a flashback to when he was younger, Cole speaks to his mother after having gotten into a fight with a bully at school. He apologizes for his actions and promises to be better, but Lilly assures him that she is already proud and makes him promise that he will continue to fight those who are cruel and unjust. In the present, he leads the Upply through Rock-bottom, however they doubt his leadership capabilities, prompting frustration from him when they discover themselves to have walked in yet another circle.

Feeling down, Cole is approached by Wu, who questions what is wrong. Cole explains how he has felt his mothers presence ever since he saw her locket, but feels foolish for thinking so. Wu points out how he has never been lower, and tells him how he should try to connect with his element. After a bit of time, he manages to do so, revealing a path through the pool to an exit, and tells the others to follow, with Plundar being reluctant. The group swims through the water, and when Vania is frightened by a skeleton, Cole helps her regain her focus. However he discovers Wu has been trapped and goes back to rescue him, Wu thanks him and Cole points out how Wu has already saved him many times in the past.

The Upply continue to find a tunnel filled with lava with only some stepping stones leading across. Plundar expresses frustration and doubt at this, at which Cole tells him and the group that he was certain that it was the way and that they needed to take a chance. Plundar, still hesitant, reluctantly follows as he leaps across the stones. However, Cole stops the group when he feels tremors in the earth, claiming he had never felt anything like it. Shortly after, a magma monster erupts from the lava. Cole gives the group orders, and with his leadership, they are able to sink the monster back into the lava. He blocks the exit afterwards, with Plundar apologizing for his behavior earlier, and the group carries on down the tunnel.

Masters Never Quit[]

Pursued once again by the lava monster, Cole and the Upply leap into some old abandoned minecarts, with him expressing how his idea worked. However, the carts quickly pick up speed, prompting fear from the group when the cart begins to tilt. Luckily, they make it, however the minecarts crash.

The group discovers themselves to have crashed in front of two large doors, with Cole having an odd feeling about the place. Wu tells him it is the heart of the mountain. After a failed attempt from Korgran, Cole walks up to the door and touches it, causing it to light up. The group enters the temple, with Cole approaching the statue of his mother in wonder. He reads a sign in front of it and touches it, causing light to flow through the statue and the temple, lighting up a mural on the floor.

He learns that his mother managed to perform the Spinjitzu Burst from the pictures on the floor, prompting Vania to ask him to attempt it. Cole, however, expresses doubt at this, but attempts anyways. After a few moments of gathering energy, all he manages to perform is a normal Spinjitzu tornado, prompting frustration towards himself. He begins to slam the ground while quakes begin to occur, with him questioning if he had been the source of them. Fungus, using his magic, shows the group that Grief-Bringer is attacking the Ninja. Cole expresses concern for his friends, but when Wu tells him the only way to save him is with the Spinjitzu Burst, he storms off upset. Realizing he has been neglecting his student, Wu encourages Cole to get up, and tells him that burst or no, they would fight Grief-Bringer.

The Ascent[]

Cole and the others are briefed by Wu, with Cole coming up with an idea to get to the surface by strapping the minecarts wheels onto the mech, however the idea receives doubt from Plundar. When Cole jumps into the mechs cockpit to put his plan to work, he discovers it has no controls, causing confusion. However, shortly after he and Wu discover it is operated by his elemental powers, allowing him to control the mech. However, he struggles to keep his balance, causing it to almost fall on the Upply and Adam several times. Luckily, he manages to pull it together eventually.

Later on, when readying the cart and mech up to put his idea to work, he encourages a troubled Vania, telling her she would not be alone, prompting gratitude from her, at which she affirms she is ready. With this, Cole powers up the mech and they speed up the rails, however the Lava Monster sees them while passing, causing it to lay chase to them yet again. After a brief chase, they loose the monster for a bit but are attacked by a swarm of Dire Bats. Although they manage to fend the bats off, the Lava monster continues to chase them, At which it manages to pin the mech down. After a brief fight, Cole manages to free himself, but sees the minecart is close to the end of the rails. He hurries to the minecart, managing to slice the magma monster with his word and catching the cart on time. However, the lava, now coating the mech, heats up the controls, causing them to crash when they get to the surface.

After the crash, he checks on Vania, and the group goes to confront Vangelis. However, when they get there, all they find is Chompy. Cole uses his lava arm to free the dragon from his cage, however Hailmar enters the room, believing Cole to be a traitor. Vania tells him she will hold Hailmar off, but he remains reluctant to leave her behind. However, in the end, Wu manages to convince him and the Upply to leave to confront the Skull Sorcerer.

The Upply Strike Back![]

Cole eavesdrops on the Skull Sorcerer, although unable to hear anything. When asked about what he was saying, Cole claimed he had heard enough villain speeches to know he was babbling on about his plan, which turns out to be true. When the Skull Sorcerer showed the ninja the blades, Cole got upset, claiming they belonged to his mother. After the Skull Sorcerer leaves, he devises a plan, telling Korgran and Fungus to wait for his signal as him and Plundar went for the blades.

Later on, he and Plundar follow two Awakened Warriors into a vault, quickly dispatching them and taking the blades. He tells Plundar to free his friends, when questioned as to what he himself would do, Cole replied with that he would have a word with Vangelis.

When Vangelis ordered the release of Grief-bringer, Cole destroyed the awakened warrior before it could release the skeletal dragon, prompting anger from Grief-Bringer and it's master when Vangelis found out it hadn't been released. He questioned who had sabotaged his plan, causing Cole to reveal himself, jokingly asking the Skull Sorcerer to guess. A fight breaks out between the two, and his friends cheer for him. After the Skull Sorcerer tells him he is outmatched, Cole answers that the blades would help him, causing Vangelis to mock him over his faith, and the two clash.

The Son of Lilly[]

Cole continues to battle the Skull Sorcerer using the Blades of Deliverance . However he is told that his mother lied to her followers because he knows that they don’t have power. Although he refuses to believe it the blades are soon destroyed. The Skull Sorcerer proceeded to mock the earth ninja for his belief in his mother. Enraged by his mother being ridiculed, Cole soon unlocks the ability to use the Spinjitzu Burst. Cole ends up destroying the Skull of Hazza D'ur. This renders Vangelis powerless and he begs Cole to spare him and pleads for mercy. Cole tells Vangelis that if he wants mercy, he should beg the Geckles and Munce tribes and his people to forgive him for his cruelty and lies. He then watches Vania have the guards take their former king away.

Later he is present at the ceremony, where Vania is appointed as Queen. He is pleased by the sight and cheers her on. As he and the others prepare to leave, Cole bids the Upply goodbye. He then shares a moment with Vania and they part on good terms with her promising to help him in the future.

The Island

The Island[]

Uncharted[]

Cole can be seen drinking water out of a bottle as P.I.X.A.L. and Lloyd plan their course of action.

He is with the others as they speak to Twitchy Tim, and is surprised to hear how many times he has been struck by lightning.

When Twitchy tells him he saw a beach of blue sand, Cole is doubtful and comes to the conclusion that Twitchy must have hit his head hard, however Twitchy becomes infuriated by his disbelief. When Twitchy faints aboard the bounty, Cole catches him and tells the others he may need a life-jacket.

When they deploy to sea, he rides aboard Jay and Kai's catamaran, being confused when Jay whispers and showing frustration when he breaks the button.

He helps the others tilt the catamaran, and is with them when they land on the island.

The Keepers of the Amulet[]

As the others discuss Lloyd's concerns, Cole expresses hunger, asking if anyone had brought a snack. When Jay at first says he did, he cheers up, but turns gloomy at the false hope when Jay tells him it fell into the ocean.

He is seen eating some berries shortly after. When Twitchy tells them the berries are poisonous, Cole spits them out.

Later on, Kai remarks on his hunger, claiming he could hear his belly grumbling. However, much to his confusion, Cole informs his friend that it wasn't his stomach. When Zippy leaps at Nya, Cole gets ready to attack the dragon, but lowers his guard when Nya and Zane point out that the creature is docile. He then starts chasing the coconut Zippy brought with him, but soon looses it to the playful dragon and expresses disappointment.

When handed a coconut by Kai, he is grateful, however confused when Kai gives him a look, questioning it. Kai asks him if he is capable of thinking about anything asides from food, and Cole responds that he is thirsty as well. However, shortly afterwards, Zippy comes and takes the coconut, with Cole giving chase to the dragon until it drops the coconut and licks him, to which he expresses disgust and allows Zippy to keep it.

When fighting the Stone Guardians, he attempts to use his powers on it, however shows confusion when it is sent back at him.

He is with the ninja when they escape the golems, and tells Jay to open his eyes after he finishes crossing the bridge.

Shortly after, he is taken by the Keepers and wakes up along with Kai and Jay on a boat, heading to a village.

He is with the ninja when Mammatus informs them of the Storm Amulet, and shows concerns. His concerns are justified when the Keepers proclaim the ninja their prisoners, expressing his distaste at this.

The Gift of Jay[]

He tells the Keepers to back off when they guide the ninja to their cell, expressing concern for Jay. When locked into the cell, he attempts to break out using his Earth Punch, but it proves ineffective and the Keepers charge the gate with lightning, causing him to be knocked back onto the ground.

He expresses concern for Master Wu and Misako, although is relieved to see them, asking how they are. He expresses doubts towards Clutch Powers, believing he may have attempted to steal the amulet.

He is with the ninja when they are saved by Lloyd, expressing relief. He shows annoyance when they find out Clutch is missing as well, and tells him to leave the amulet. However, in the end, they all end up getting caught again and are tied up to a pole, with Cole claiming to have gotten tired of being zapped as a spear hits his pole.

He shows relief when Jay comes, asking if he can get the Keepers to free the Ninja, however when they sacrifice Jay, he shows fear and attempts to get out of the ropes binding him.

The Tooth of Wojira[]

Cole expresses concern for Jay and attempts to rescue him, however arrives too late.

He confronts Mammatus alongside the rest, and listens to Mammatus tale.

He arrives with the others in time to save Jay, knocking pit a few goons and catching him. He explains alongside the rest how they found him, and he and Kai catch Ronin after Twitchy sinks his boat. The two of them lock Ronin away, and forgive Mammatus, telling him that they have gone through similar events in the past.

The Virtues of Spinjitzu

The Virtues of Spinjitzu[]

Curiosity[]

Cole entered the courtyard after Wu was shocked to see a giant hole in the middle of the wall. After Jay, Kai, and Nya failed to remember the six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu, Wu looked around to see if the other ninja remembered, but they all looked down with guilt on their face.

With the ninja forgetting the virtues, Wu ordered them to medidate immediately. While medidating, Cole was medidating on a brick of cement, so Wu knocked him to the ground. While Wu was attending to the door, Cole continued to medidate even when Nya heard a roar in the background. When Nya investigated by opening the door, they was shocked to see Wu grasped by a green dragon. The ninja tried to fight the dragon, but the dragon was able to deflect their attacks and escape through a portal. The ninja then entered the portal hoping to save their master.

Balance[]

Cole was the first ninja to come out of the portal in an illusion of the Sepertine Pyramid. He and the others saw the green dragon holding Wu and taking him to another portal, leaving two other dragons to guard the gateway. Cole watched Lloyd and Jay trying different paths to reach the portal on the other side but both of their plans proved to be ineffective. Cole and the remaining ninja were shocked to see Pyro Vipers awake from their sarcophagi and the Lava Monster rising from the lava pool.

Later, Cole was the only ninja not to be stuck on some wooden pillars on the lava pool, he was overwhelmed with all the chaos happening, so he closed his eyes to try to find balance, he was thinking of a memory of him watching his parents dance, which inspired him to use a few dance moves to be able to avoid being attacked by the Pyro Whippers and the Lava Monster and to jump above it. Cole then used his Earth Punch to throw down a rock on top of the Lava Monster which sank it in the lava. He later discovered that the two dragons were not in fact evil and he allied with them to save the others and to fly to the portal.

Wisdom[]

Cole and the ninja raced in the Speedway Five-Billion attempting to reach the portal at the finish line. However, the Whack Rats were blocking their way and kept respawning every time they were defeated. Lloyd then realized they needed to be defeated in order to get across and after he "died", he respawned near the portal. The rest of the ninja followed suit and entered the next portal.

Honesty[]

Cole and the ninja were trapped in a cage and watched as Kai and Jay jousted in order to earn their freedom. After Jay told the truth of falling in his win, the Ice Emperor was pleased Jay told the truth and freed the rest of the ninja. The Ice Emperor then opened the next portal for the ninja to find Wu.

Generosity[]

Cole and the ninja fought the Awakened Warriors in the Mines of Shintaro. While fighting, he saw Master Wu being taken by the Legendary Dragon into the next portal. He tried to use his Earth Punch, but was unable due to the Vengestone being in the area. When Zane told the others to save the Geckles, Cole first hesitated but was later convinced by Zane to save them. After saving the Geckles from the warriors, the ninja used the catapult to launch themselves to the next portal.

Courage[]

Cole and the ninja found themselves on the Island of the Keepers with Cole in his mech. They discovered Wu held captive by the Legendary Dragon along with three other dragons surrounded by a forcefield. The ninja suggested different strategies, but Kai disregarded everything proposed by the ninja and took the dragons head on. After Kai destroyed the forcefield, he and Zane destroyed one of the smaller dragons. Despite the ninja defeating the dragons and saving Wu, their master informed them it was merely a lesson to teach the six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu.

Seabound

Seabound[]

A Big Splash[]

When Miss Demeanor is chased by the ninja and almost gets away, he appears by the pass with his Dirt Bike, asking if it was too soon for him to interfere as he launched two missiles at her goons trucks, causing them to crash. However, Demeanor manages to stop his bike, causing him to be forced to run out of the way when the truck passes, allowing her to get away. He then notices the Vengestone the trucks had been smuggling, recognizing it as such.

When Nya's powers go out of control and conjure a water tornado, he shows concern for the nearby village and helps the other ninja get the inhabitants onto a ledge, ensuring their safety.

Back at the monastery, he explains what happened to Wu and tells him that the trucks were smuggling Vengestone, he witnesses Nya's frustration and tries to calm her down.

He is there when Wu researches Nya's powers, confused by the fact that the First Spinjitzu Master never mastered Water or Wind. He tells Kai not to blame his parents when Kai mentions the fact that he and Nya grew up alone.

He is playing a video game with a stash of soda bottles when Nya passes by, her powers causing the bottles to go out of control and propel him behind the couch, prompting confusion from him.

He is there when Wu confronts Nya about her powers, and witnesses her reunion with her mother. He shows fear when she grows enraged at her brother.

The Call of the Deep[]

Cole assists Lloyd in fixing the hangar bay's computer, informing Nya of Zane and P.I.X.A.L.'s water rescue mission.

He later helps assist the others in cleaning up the Monastery after Nya.

Unsinkable[]

Cole is there when the Hydro Bounty is unveiled, but shows concerns and points out how most ships tend to sink. However, after getting looks from the others, he quickly dismisses the idea.

He is said to be staying back at the Monastery by Kai, who tells Ray that Cole isn't as good as him at playing Prime Empire. Cole disagrees with this, joining the two of them in a game while Maya watches fondly from the doorway.

The Storm Amulet[]

Nya briefly speaks to him and tells him where the amulet is located, with Cole at first being confused but then realizing what was going on and assuring her he and the others would find it.

Riddle of the Sphinx[]

Cole goes out into the courtyard of the Monastery to warn Ray, Kai and Wu, and the four, along with Misako, head out to the Explorer's Club to retrieve the amulet.

However, when they arrive, Cecil attempts to turn the group away as they lack membership, but Misako points out how they can invoke a Trial by Sphinx. Cecil is astounded by this proclamation, and remarks on what happened to Lord Belgrave, at which Cole shows fear. However, Misako remains stubborn, and the trial is initiated.

The Sphinx appears and asks it's riddle, with Cole answering incorrectly with cake without hesitation. Wu questions him on this, to which Cole replies that he believes cake is the answer to everything. Wu, enraged by this, responds that discipline is usually the answer to everything, and attempts to answer the riddle, however it is incorrect. Finally, Kai manages to answer it correctly, causing the Sphinx to disappear back into the floor and the group is permitted passage.

The group enters the room in which Clutch was making his presentation, causing Clutch, shocked, to quickly step in front of the amulet and greet them anxiously. Cole, frustrated by this, tells him to drop the charade, at which Clutch fakes confusion. However, when Kalmaar enters, Clutch quickly hands it over to the ninja and runs, fearing for his safety. The other members of the club show distaste of this, and a fight breaks out between the ninja and Kalmaar.

Papergirl[]

The ninja continue their fight with Kalmaar, with the amulet escaping Kalmaar and rolling towards Nelson and Antonia. Kai tells them to get the amulet to safety as Cole and the rest of the group attack Kalmaar in attempts to delay him.

Cole and Wu later catch up with Kai, Antonia and Nelson after Kalmaar flees, expressing gratitude to the two for saving their friend.

Master of the Sea[]

Cole assists Wu, Misako, Kai and Ray in an attempt to secure the Storm Amulet from Kalmaar, however he is later surrounded by the Maaray Guards alongside Kai and Ray.

He is later tied with the others to an anchor, and Kalmaar attempts to dump them into the ocean. Just then, the Hydro Bounty appears under them, and he and the others are cut loose. Cole assist in the ensuing fight, and he is there to witness Nya retrieve the Storm Amulet.

He later takes the Storm Amulet to Shintaro for safe keeping, handing it over to Queen Vania, and the two place it inside a vault. When Hailmar asks about it, he tells the guard grimly that it must never see the light of day again.

Assault on Ninjago City[]

While Kai and Zane are being outnumbered by the Merlopians, Cole arrives and assists them, with the two expressing gratitude towards him. He assists in evacuating the citizens. Cole and Benthomaar then split up from the rest and attempt to take down some of the Merlopians.

Nyad[]

As Jay's Sub car is flooding and he kicks at the door frantically, Benthomaar and Cole arrive and open the cockpit, taking him to the surface. The two hand the weak ninja over to the others, with Cole informing them he had inhaled a large amount of water.

He is there as Jay is checked on by the others, and shows concern for his friend when he is informed of his condition. He suggests contacting Vania, but Zane informs him that they couldn't communicate this far, prompting disappointment from him.

When Nya sits with Jay, Cole is asleep, however wakes up when the water in Jay's lungs is drawn out, and shows concern when told by Benthomaar what Nya is attempting to do. He follows the others when they try to stop their friend, however they arrive too late. He shows concern for his friend when Jay arrives onto the rooftop, but agrees to assist Nya.

The Turn of the Tide[]

He witnesses Nya's battle against Wojira and Kalmaar, showing concern for her whenever she is blasted. He and Lloyd spot some of the Merlopians on the rooftop, and assist in defeating them. He shows surprise and concern when Nya adopts her dragon form, and continues to observe the fight. He witnesses Nya defeat Wojira, and expresses happiness for his friend's victory. However, he shows concern when she interacts with Jay, and when she leaves.

After Nya leaves, Cole comforts Jay over this, holding his friend close and reassuring him that some of their allies would come, however shows surprise at the amount of people who managed to arrive. He attends Nya's memorial, pouring a bowl of water into the vase with the others. When Jay finishes pouring his bowl and sniffles, Cole lays a hand on his friend's shoulder in an attempt to comfort him, and grieves for his friend silently alongside the rest.

After Seabound

After Seabound[]

The Sea Beast! (non-canon)[]

A couple of days after Nya's sacrifice, P.I.X.A.L. dropped Cole, Lloyd, Zane, Kai and Jay to the beach in order to try to find Nya. Cole and the others asked many different fishermen if they saw her and Wojira but all the stories they told ended up being being fake. The ninja also encountered a boy in the beach who recommended them to collect rubbish and gave them a bag so that they could also clean the beach.

Later the ninja went to the harbor were they saw a mysterious seller who was trying to sell a sea monster hidden under a big white blanket, the ninja first theorized that the beast was Wojira but they later saw Miss Demeanor who was trying to obtain the sea monster. The ninja were later able to stop her and her henchmen with the rubbish they collected from the beach. The ninja later discovered that the seller was Ronin who was trying to sell a fake sea monster. Miss Demeanor was arrested and Ronin was given a warning by the Commissioner.

Tentacles Below![]

Not too long after their previous adventure, Cole and the ninja were informed that a sea monster was able to infiltrate in the city's sewer system during the Great Flood so they went to the city and were they saved the Commissioner from one of the tentacles. Cole and the others later went inside the sewers were they discovered that the sea monster there was a baby Leviathan, after the ninja failed to defeat it they decided to help it get out of the sewers.

Unfortunately most of their ideas didn't work that well and they had to bring the baby Leviathan up through a hole which was too high to reach, luckily they received help from the Leviathan Zane saved from his father's lighthouse. The mother of the baby Leviathan brought the ninja back to the lighthouse and the ninja decided to go inside to find a radio to contact P.I.X.A.L. so that she could pick them up.

Back to Merlopia![]

One day, following a visit to the Monastery by Glutinous, Cole and the other ninja learned of Gripe's return to Merlopia and his intentions of seizing the throne in Benthomaar's absence. After some preparations, the ninja set out to Merlopia to stop Gripe's attempted coup. After diving into the waters surrounding Merlopia with their APS suits, the ninja briefly fought against one of Gripe's patrols before making their way to the palace itself.

After sneaking into the palace through one of the supply hatches, Cole and the others encountered Gripe and his forces. After a brief skirmish with the Maaray Soldiers, Gripe and forces began retreating towards the palace. The ninja gave chase and attempted to intercept their foes by traveling through one of the lower tunnels, but unfortunately, Gripe had anticipated for the ninja to take such action and ordered for the lower tunnel to be flooded. The ninja surely would have drowned had it not been for the intervention of Glutinous, and Cole thanked the scientist afterwards for saving them. After recovering from this experience, the ninja hastily rushed towards the throne room to confront Gripe and his forces.

In response to seeing the ninja and their survival, Gripe and his followers simply responded by locking themselves inside the throne room, leaving the ninja without anyway inside. While the others watched as Kai lost his temper and chided Lloyd for his poor leadership, Cole stepped in and broke up the two before things could heat up any further. When Kai began a brazen attack against the throne room door, tearing it apart before single handedly defeating Gripe and his forces, Cole was the only ninja to express reservations about his teammate's actions, even reprimanding Kai afterwards for the latter's reckless behavior. Cole's words however, fell upon deaf ears and Kai brushed him off, dismissing Cole's concerns as being nothing more than hypotheticals. With the immediate threat now quelled, Cole departed Merlopia alongside the other ninja.

Great Droids Think Alike[]

Cole was at the monastery and was recalling the times he and the other ninja had together until he realized that the team is starting to break up due to Nya's sacrifice. With the sacrifice causing Jay to be in a depressive state, Kai acting more impulsive, and Lloyd losing his leadership. While he was strolling, he saw parts of Zane's new mech and was wondering what Zane and P.I.X.A.L. were up to.

Bad Water[]

After a particularly intense training session, Cole and Kai headed towards the Monastery's showers. Not long after entering the room, however, the pair learned from Jay that the Monastery's water had been tainted, and instead, the three suited up to warn Wu about it. After learning that the Monastery drew its water from the same source as Ninjago City, Cole realized that the entire city's tap water could be tainted as well, prompting the ninja to investigate. It would not take long for them to confirm this assumption, however, and Cole suggested following the tainted river to determine the cause behind the contamination. After following the river for some time, the ninja discovered an illegal mining operation that was utilizing fracking techniques to mine out a vein of vengestone. While Kai explained fracking to the others, Cole pulled out a pair of binoculars and looked to see who were behind the mining operation; unsurprisingly, it was their old foe, Miss Demeanor.

Following Lloyd's orders, Cole and the others launched an attack on the mining operation with Spinjitzu. Although this worked at first, after Miss Demeanor and her goons recovered from the initial attack, they retaliated by blasting the ninja with contaminated water. After retreating, Cole groaned about the failure of their plan and listened as Jay proposed a new one. As part of Jay's plan, all four ninja climbed aboard the former's sub car and drove towards the mining operation to catch Miss Demeanor's attention. However, due to the sub car only having two seats, Cole and Kai were forced to ride on the roof. Although Kai complained about having to ride on the roof, Cole pointed out that they didn't have many other options in stopping Miss Demeanor and her goons. After catching Miss Demeanor's attention, she and her forces gave chase, eventually catching up to the sub car. As their foes neared, Cole pretended to lament their situation, loudly proclaiming that with four ninja onboard the sub car, they were overburdened and thus could not possibly outrun Miss Demeanor and her goons.

As they neared the polluted river, Jay dove into it, converting his car to sub mode to traverse the contaminated waters. The goons on the other hand, were not so fortunate. Due to speeding on ahead in an effort to catch up with the ninja, the goons were unable to brake in time and crashed their mining vehicle into the river. With their vehicle disabled, Cole and the other ninja launched themselves to attack and swiftly rounded up the stranded goons. Miss Demeanor on the other hand, managed to escape once more. Although Lloyd tried to rally up the ninja to give chase, Cole dismissed the pursuit, explaining that the health of Ninjago City's citizens was more important and their priority right now was in notifying the Police Commissioner about their findings so that the river could be cleaned up.

Separate Ways[]

Responding to a call by the Police Commissioner, Cole, Kai, and Lloyd made their way to a nature preserve where several citizens had built treehouses to serve as shelters in case of another Great Flood. After being briefed on the situation, Cole urged the other two to follow his lead in stealthily climbing up the trees, where he then tried talking to some of the citizens. When the people refused to leave, Cole suggested relocating them to another forest that wasn't a nature preserve and called in Destiny's Bounty to relocate them after pointing out that the people would not have to step foot on solid ground if they were in the air!

After overseeing the relocation operation for some time, Jay arrived in the nature preserve to request assistance in responding to a distress signal sent out by a cargo ship. Cole agreed to accompany Jay and asked Kai to take over the resettlement operation. Some time later, the pair discovered that Captain Soto was up to his old tricks again and had managed to convince another group of terrified citizens to attack anything associated with the sea, including ships! After some quick thinking by Jay, he and Cole took the fight to Soto, capturing him in less than a minute. After securing him aboard Jay's sub car, the two realized they were close to Lighthouse Island and decided to stop by for a brief visit.

When Jay decided that he wanted to stay on the island, Cole encouraged him to do so if Jay believed it could help him to rediscover his smile following Nya's sacrifice. Jay then bequeathed the sub car to Cole, who took it to bring Soto back to prison.

After Kai, Lloyd and Jay all left the monastery, Zane, Cole and P.I.X.A.L. decided to stay there alone in the following months.

Crystalized

Crystalized[]

Farewell the Sea[]

After losing Nya, the ninja went their separate ways. Cole and Zane stayed at the monastery and were down at Hanger bay working on their vehicles. While working, Cole overheard Mayor Trustable about the Vengestone situation and how the destructive the ninja were. This angered Cole who stormed out of hangar bay looking for Wu.

Cole found Wu sorting through scrolls in hopes of finding a way to bring Nya back. Cole informed Wu about the Vengestone being transported and Wu agreed the ninja needed to come together.

Hoping to bring the ninja back, Cole and Zane head to Kai's dojo where Kai is teaching martial arts to kids. After Kai is finished teaching his class, Cole and Zane asked if Kai wanted to return to the team and he agreed.

The three ninja then head to Lloyd who is washing windows in Ninjago City. They tried to convince Lloyd to join, but Lloyd snapped back and insisted on not joining due to believing he was at lost for losing Nya. After failing to get Lloyd, they headed to Jay who was at Lighthouse Island. However, they find a bearded Jay talking to water, believing he was talking to Nya. They tried to get Jay to join the team, but he refused. Before the Cole, Kai, and Zane left, Cole saw something in the Endless Ocean and informed Jay about it. Jay went out and saw candlelights floating on the waters and with messages about Nya. After seeing nobody forgot about Nya and Lloyd deciding to join, the ninja reunited.

The Shape of Nya[]

Within the Samurai X Cave beneath the Monastery, Cole questioned how it was that the mysterious Vengestone Buyer could have been transporting so much of the material without being seen. After noticing that Jay seemed unfocused and uninterested in their mission, Cole gently called him over to pitch in with the discussion, though he seemed disappointed when Jay flatly said 'no' in response to Cole's questions. Nevertheless, Cole gently pointed out that they were going to need a bit more effort from him than just 'no.'

Later, after following Jay's suggestion of investigating the abandoned N line, Cole cautiously approached a railcar that had been covered with a sheet after the sheet moved. Armed with his hammer, Cole slowly removed the sheet, discovering to his surprise that a man lay inside atop a pile of vengestone. After prodding the man in the shoulder with his hammer and receiving no response, Cole turned towards his friends and muttered that his thoughts that the man wasn't breathing. At that moment, the man awoke and stood up, startling Cole as he turned towards him.

When Miss Demeanor and her goons arrived, Cole fought against them with Spinjitzu, though he accidentally struck Jay in the process. When the New Ninja intervened, swiftly defeating Miss Demeanor and her thugs, Cole watched their graceful movements in wonderment, wondering aloud how they were able to defeat their foes so quickly. After returning to the cave to debrief, Cole comforted Lloyd about their situation, emphasizing that no one could replace them as Ninja while also emphasizing that Zane had turned off his emotions and quite literally couldn't care about their predicament. When Nya appeared before her friends and expressed a way for her to be restored to her human form, Cole voted in favor of freeing Aspheera without hesitation.

A Mayor Problem[]

Cole and the other ninja paid a visit to City Hall to request for Mayor Trustable to release Aspheera from prison so that they could help restore Nya to her flesh and blood. When the conversation soured and the mayor refused to grant the request, Cole stopped Lloyd from arguing any further with him and quietly urged them to just go.

Some time later, the ninja gathered together in the Samurai X Cave, where Lloyd came forward with a new idea: if they couldn't release Aspheera legally, they would have to do it illegally. Althoug this horrified Wu to no end, Cole and the others immediately agreed to Lloyd's proposition and split into two teams: Cole and Jay would head to Borg Tower to retrieve Aspheera's staff, while Lloyd, Kai, and Zane broke her out of Kryptarium. With the teams decided on, P.I.X.A.L. provided Cole and Jay with an elevator bypass code for Borg Tower, though unbeknownst to Cole, Jay failed to pay attention whatsoever as P.I.X.A.L. relayed this information.

A few hours later, Cole and Jay made their way to Borg Tower, disguised as a pair of employees. As they entered the elevator, Cole asked Jay about the bypass code, though Jay stated he did not know it because P.I.X.A.L. had directed that information to Cole and that he only stood next to Cole. Refusing to argue, Cole simply stated that the code could either be "3314" or "4413." Jay then guessed the latter, which turned out to be incorrect and instead triggered the tower's alarm. Shocked by this, Jay pinned the blame solely on Cole, lamenting that Cole's failure to pay attention now landed them in this mess. Refusing to argue, Cole looked around to think of a solution, deciding shortly to just simply remove one of the elevator's floor panels, revealing the lift's cables underneath. Cole then interrupted Jay's hysterics and suggested that they could climb down to escape, quickly sliding down as Jay briefly complained about this new suggestion before following suit.

Eventually, Cole and Jay made it to the vaults where Aspheera's staff was held. As they approached, Cole warned Jay to be careful, for the vaults held a collection of dangerous artifacts from the ninja's past. Without a keycode to unlock the door, the two resorted to simply blasting it open with their elemental powers, only to discover to their surprise that the vaults were entirely empty!

Public Enemies 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5![]

Unsuccessful in their mission, Cole and Jay returned to the Samurai X Cave just in time to overhear Lloyd telling Aspheera that the latter's staff would be arriving momentarily. As he stepped up towards the others, Cole bluntly stated that their mission had been a failure, angrily throwing his cap to the floor in the process. When Lloyd asked what had happened, Cole simply said that everything in the Borg Tower vaults were gone.

Later, after P.I.X.A.L. asked Cyrus Borg about the whereabouts of the staff, and he responded by providing the ninja with a schedule about its transport elsewhere, the ninja briefly discussed the feasibility of upgrading their vehicles within eight hours to steal the staff. P.I.X.A.L. then stated it would take her over six-hundred hours to prepare modifications for the ninja's vehicles, but she would have them ready "shortly." As she cheerily walked off and was out of earshot, Cole muttered aloud that something about P.I.X.A.L.'s statement didn't make any sense to him.

Eight hours later, the ninja were equipped with their upgraded vehicles and began making their way to intercept the armored transport that was carrying Aspheera's staff. As P.I.X.A.L. began to explain the upgrades, starting with how each vehicle was now coated in advanced paint that could change color, Cole exclaimed that he would pick black and immediately altered the color of his Dragon Cruiser. After identifying the specific armored truck that was carrying Aspheera's staff, Cole and the other three ninja with ground based vehicles boxed in the truck before setting their vehicles to auto-pilot. The four then boarded the truck while Zane deployed a magnetic winch to lift the truck into the air, flying off with it.

Unfortunately, to the dismay of the ninja, the New Ninja had been assigned to guard the interior of this specific truck. When the Teal Ninja began to say his team's catchphrase, Cole cut off him and rushed forward to attack, roughly throwing him to the side and beginning an altercation between both teams. Throughout the fight, Cole grappled against the Fuchsia Ninja and later the Pink Ninja when the latter stopped Cole from grabbing Aspheera's staff. The fight would be halted, however, when Kai, in exasperation, let Zane's name slip out, cluing in the New Ninja to the identity of the black robed ninja they were fighting. Moments later, Jay would retrieve Aspheera's staff, and Cole and the other three would retreat by climbing atop of Zane's winch while the armored truck and the New Ninja were safely set to the ground.

A Painful Promise[]

Cole returned to the Monastery alongside the other four ninja with Aspheera's staff. When Aspheera betrayed the ninja, however, Cole was forced to duck for cover as Aspheera fired blasts of magic through her naginata, declaring that she would have her revenge! Moments later, the New Ninja arrived to arrest the ninja for the crimes they had committed in the name of saving Nya. As the New Ninja stormed the cave and confronted the ninja, Cole expressed confusion about the Teal Ninja's phrasing of their mission, specifically taking issue with "Un-break it."

Cole and the other four ninja then held off the New Ninja while Aspheera drained Nya of her powers and restored her to her flesh and blood. Once Nya was safe, Cole surrendered to the New Ninja and was hauled away in a helicopter to answer for his crimes.

Ninjago City vs. Ninja[]

Following their trial in Ninjago City v. Ninja, Cole and the others were convicted and now awaited sentencing. As they waited, Cole moaned about their situation, wondering aloud how the jury managed to convict so quickly. Not long afterwards, the Honorable Judge William Toughbutt sentenced all five ninja to five years in Kryptarium Prison for breaking Aspheera out of prison and stealing her staff from its armored convoy.

When the ninja were led to their cell in Kryptarium, Cole once again lamented about the ninja's situation, mumbling under his breath that he wouldn't be sleeping much in their cell. In response to this, Zane stated matter-of-factly that if Cole did not intend to sleep much, he would take Cole's bunk, much to the confusion of the former. Jay then criticized Zane for his calm demeanor, leading for Zane to turn his emotions back on to "react appropriately." Unfortunately, since Zane's "appropriate reaction" consisted of screaming as loudly as possible in a horrifying manner, Cole and Kai were quick to deactivate their friend's emotions once more, which Cole added were not helpful to their present case.

The next day, the ninja were let out into the prison's yard where they briefly glanced at several of the other inmates they had locked up, including Ultra Violet, Mezmo, and a Skulkin. As their former foes all glared at the ninja, Cole muttered his opinion that he felt as if they were not welcome in the prison. When the Main Guard shortly intervened and broke up a heated conversation between the ninja and Ronin, Cole briefly stepped towards Ronin's retreating group with a scowl before noticing the presence of the guard. He and the other ninja, save Lloyd, would soon be returned to their cells while Lloyd was taken to meet a visitor.

When Lloyd returned to his cell later on, Cole asked him who the visitor was.

Kryptarium Prison Blues[]

Alongside the other ninja, Cole was let out of his cell to attend a visitation session with Skylor and Dareth, the latter of whom claimed to have discovered a way to have the ninja released from prison. As they spoke, Cole learned to his shock that his old enemy, Vangelis the former Skull Sorcerer, had been mysteriously freed from his prison in Shintaro - undoubtedly the work of the Crystal King. To further ruin the mood, Dareth revealed that his plan to have the ninja released was to request a retrial on the grounds that they didn't like the judge's verdict, much to Cole's frustration as he facepalmed in response to Dareth's claim.

Around lunchtime, Cole sat with the other ninja in Kryptarium's courtyard, picking at bowls of green gloop that Cole originally believed to be some kind of oatmeal. At the very least, the prison gave out slices of delicious cake! Unfortunately, when Cole eagerly took a large bite of the cake, anticipating for his teeth to sink into its "moist" and "chewy" surface, he instead nearly chipped a tooth and recoiled in disgust from the rock hard slice. At that moment, Pythor, whom the ninja had not seen in years, approached their table and made several dismissive comments about them and there situation, infuriating Kai who rose to his feet and prepared to attack. With the help of Lloyd, Cole managed to briefly restrain Kai from attacking their old foe, but Kai broke free and smacked Pythor in the face with his serving tray, provoking a fight between him and the ninja. During the food fight, Cole used his serving tray to shield himself from the bowls and rock hard slices of cake that were hurled by Pythor and the other inmates, being the only ninja to refrain from fighting back. The altercation was then halted by the Main Guard who ordered for all the prisoners involved to return to their cells.

Later that night, Cole was fast asleep in his bunk when Lloyd began banging from underneath to rouse him awake, shouting that he had witnessed several Crystal Spiders crawl past towards Pythor's cell. With Kai's help at melting the bars, Cole and the others rushed off to give chase to their escaping foe. Unfortunately, Pythor managed to escape, leaving the ninja behind and surrounded by multiple guards who had been mobilized to pursue the escaping prisoners. As the were taken back to their cells, Cole moaned about the possibility of having another twenty years added to their sentences.

Hounddog McBrag[]

Cole and the other ninja were awoken by the Main Guard to report for work. As he exited their cell, Cole briefly yawned and leaned against the nearby banister before joining in on the ongoing conversation, expressing his opinion that being put to work was better than sitting in a cell all day. As he stepped onto the prison bus to be transported to his work site, Cole took a seat in the back of the bus and listened as the Main Guard explained how they would all be cleaning up litter from Route 22. When the guard explained how those who worked hard would receive lemonade, Cole smacked his lips and muttered to himself how a glass of lemonade seemed nice right about now.

As the bus traveled alongside the Sea of Sand and briefly stopped for the guards to assist an elderly man with a broken engine, Cole carefully studied the man, feeling that there was something familiar about his appearance. Seconds later, Nya landed behind the prison bus in her new Samurai X Mech and tore open the backdoor, allowing for Cole and the other ninja to escape. The elderly man then drove his van over to where the ninja were hiding and gestured for them to board, taking off at high speed and leaving the guards behind!

After driving for some time, the man pulled off his hat and fake beard, revealing his identity as none other than Dareth, leading for Cole to exclaim that he always suspected the man was him! After shaking off a lone police cruiser, Dareth's engine actually gave out, forcing Cole and the others to put on the new uniforms provided by P.I.X.A.L. and traverse the desert on foot. As they walked through the sweltering sands, Cole wiped his brow and mumbled that while he appreciated P.I.X.A.L. for providing them with new uniforms, he admitted that they were not exactly the best things to wear to lay low. By nightfall, with the Ninjago Police combing the desert in search of the ninja, Cole stopped his friends to develop a new plan, warning that they couldn't keep wandering aimlessly, for the police would surely catch them by then.

Heeding Cole's suggestion, Lloyd split the ninja up into two groups: he would go alongside Jay, Cole, and Fugidove in one direction while Kai, Zane, and Dareth would go the other. Their objective was to find Twitchy Tim's gas station to ask their old ally for his assistance. Although Cole agreed with the plan, he expressed reservations over the possibility of one group not making it to Twitchy's, to which Lloyd stated that should that be the case, they would assume the group was captured by the police.

The Fifth Villain[]

Continuing to wander across the Sea of Sand with his team, Cole paid no mind to Jay's increasing aggravation with Fugi-Dove, though he would on occasion poke fun at Jay's expense. Eventually, the group discovered a highway in the Sea of Sand and realized that they were close to Twitchy Tim's gas station. At this point, Fugi-Dove decided to give Jay his first lesson in crime and produced a bottle of water, sparking Cole's interest. To Cole's dismay, however, Fugi-Dove emptied the contents of the water bottle onto the parched sands before dropping the bottle as well, declaring that he had successfully committed the crime of petty vandalism! While Cole scrambled to the empty bottle, desperately looking for even a single drop of water, Fugi-Dove produced a second bottle and emptied it as well, causing Cole to cry out in anguish. By the time the group finally arrived at Twitchy Tim's gas station, Cole ran on ahead of the others to get a drink, rushing into the station to begin guzzling down several bottles.

Cole continued to drink while the other ninja discussed their next moves regarding the Crystal King, learning from Fugi-Dove the existence of a Crystal Council. Deciding it would be most efficient to capture and replace the next villain who was likely to be recruited, the ninja began to brainstorm which of their remaining, non-deceased, foes could be invited next. After several other suggestions, Jay wondered if the Mechanic could be the next villain, for after all, he had a relatively recent stint in unleashing Unagami into Ninjago. Cole agreed with Jay's suggestion, remarking that the Mechanic had since "leveled up" as a villain in his eyes. With all in agreement of the Mechanic being the next most likely recruit, the ninja prepared to leave, but discovered that Hounddog McBrag and his squadron had pulled up outside! The ninja then dove behind the gas station counter to hide, hoping to avoid detection.

As the police entered the store to search for the ninja, Twitchy Tim almost immediately gave away the ninja's hiding spot, much to Cole's discontent as he lamented that Tim was supposed to hide them. Fortunately, Fugi-Dove revealed himself and attacked the officers to take attention away from the ninja just long enough for them to escape outside. Taking one of the police SUVs, the ninja climbed aboard and sped off to Ninjago City.

Night had fallen by the time the ninja returned to Ninjago City and investigated the lair of the Mechanic. Although the derelict arcade seemed devoid of any sign of the once small time crook, the presence of many robo arms suggested his lingering presence. At that moment, the Mechanic revealed himself, attacking the ninja with his lair's many mechanical arms. Alongside Kai, Cole ripped into a Spinjitzu tornado to attack, but was batted to the side when the Mechanic grabbed ahold of Kai and slammed him into Cole. Cole was then restrained by one of the lair's mechanical arms and hoisted into the air, but fortunately, Zane was able to knock down the Mechanic in time, freeing Cole from the mechanical claws.

Once the Mechanic was defeated and restrained, Cole and the other ninja, save Lloyd, brought their prisoner onboard his own Noodle Truck of Crime, intending to use it to locate the Council of the Crystal King.

The Council of the Crystal King[]

Beginning their search for the Council of the Crystal King, Cole and Jay sat in the back of the Noodle Truck of Crime to guard their unwilling prisoner while Kai drove the truck following Zane's guidance. After driving for some time, Jay grew bored of their assignment and began rummaging through the many boxes of instant noodle cups, piquing Cole's interest. Unfortunately, this inattention gave the Mechanic the opportunity to free himself from his binds and provoke a fight as he attempted to escape the truck. In spite of Cole and Jay's best efforts at subduing him, during which Cole managed to score a few good hits on their opponent, the Mechanic was able to escape by activating the truck's mechanical arms and causing it to flip over.

Cole and the other ninja then pursued the Mechanic down into the subway tunnels where they would all be knocked into the path of an oncoming train by the villain. With the train coming his way, Cole desperately scrambled to his feet and narrowly got off the train tracks as he clutched the opposite platform edge, screaming at the top of his lungs as the train went by. In the fight that followed, Cole engaged the Mechanic in hand to hand combat but bemoaned the fact that a low-level criminal like the Mechanic was somehow giving four experienced ninja so much trouble! He would then be knocked through the air by the Mechanic, but was caught by Kai who broke his fall. Unfortunately, neither ninja were safe just yet and the Mechanic knocked both of them down into the subway tracks as Jay released bolts of lightning at their foe. Unfortunately, Jay's attack missed when the Mechanic leapt out of the way, resulting in his lightning striking the steel railway tracks below instead, carrying the electric current into shocking Cole and Kai into submission! As he collapsed onto the tracks, both Cole and Kai were saved by Zane just as another train passed by them. Although Cole was able to recover shortly thereafter, he and the others were unable to stop the Mechanic, leaving the ninja with little option beyond contacting Lloyd to warn him about their failure.

Cole then attempted to reach Lloyd over their comms, only for the signal to fail as Lloyd reached the hiding place of the Council of the Crystal King.

The Spider's Design[]

Cole and the other three ninja made their way down towards the N line, having tracked Lloyd's last known location as being within its vicinity. As they investigated, Wu contacted them to inform them of his encounter with McBrag. When pressed for good news, Wu replied that the police had also impounded the Destiny's Bounty, leading for Cole to ask Wu how they could be good news. Later, when they came across a derelict subway car, Cole watched on as Jay recognized it as a BRTM-12 and began rattling off trivia about it to the others. Shortly after, thanks to Kai's growing impatience, Cole and the others resumed their investigation of the N line.

As the ninja neared the end of the N line, Zane informed the others that his sensors were picking up a peculiar tapping sound in the surrounding area. Unsure of the source, Kai ordered the others to spread out and search for the source of the sound. Cole was investigating the tracks below when he realized that the tapping sound was edging ever closer. Raising his head towards the N line tunnel, Cole saw to his horror, hundreds of Crystal Spiders scuttling towards the ninja, all of which were armed to detonate! With a gasp, Cole turned and began tunning in the opposite direction, shouting at the top of his lungs about the danger. As they now all ran, Kai tripped twice and was helped back to his feet by Cole before all of them made their way into the BRTM-12. After the spiders detonated and the rubble settled, Jay let out a delighted chuckle at the realization that they had survived thanks to the train car, which Jay emphasized was built for strength durability. Cole however, seemed more reserved about their situation and expressed concern over their ability to escape now that the car was buried under a mountain of rubble.

The Fall of the Monastery[]

With the initial relief over surviving having worn off, Cole and the other ninja began examining their circumstances more closely. After Jay's playful boast about the BRTM-12's endurance and stability caused the rubble to shift, Cole shouted for Jay to stop touching the sides of the train car. Kai then asked if Cole could use his powers to safely clear a way out, though Cole noted that the surrounding debris seemed rather precarious. Nevertheless, Cole attempted to remove the rubble but this too threatened the ninja's current position, forcing him to stop for their safety. With no remaining options, Cole could only watch and hope as Zane attempted to reach the Monastery for aid.

After successfully reaching the team stationed at the Monastery, Cole asked Zane to emphasize to the team how dire their situation was - a point proven mere seconds later when the car's ceiling began to collapse from the weight of the debris. Fortunately, Zane was able to locate an emergency exit on the car's floor, allowing for Cole and the others to escape.

Darkness Within[]

Although Cole and the other ninja narrowly escaped from certain doom, they still remained buried beneath the damaged BRTM-12 in the collapsed subway tunnels. In exasperation, Cole grumbled aloud and asked if things could get any worse - a comment that immediately earned Kai's scorn as the latter snaped at Cole not to utter such a question. As if summoned by Cole's remark, a rat appeared before the ninja then quickly scurried off through the debris, giving Zane an idea. Acknowledging that rodents were experts at survival, Zane followed it through the loose rubble and discovered a tunnel leading towards the surface. Although Zane could not confirm the length of the tunnel, Cole considered its mere existence as being better than staying beneath the collapsed train car and hastily followed the ninja of ice.

Unfortunately, their ascension was cut short when Jay slipped and shifted the debris around them, sealing the ninja away from the surface once more. As they sat along in their 'cave', Cole noted that they just had to hang out for a bit, and sooner or later, P.I.X.A.L. would locate them. To help pass the time, Jay offered to sing a folksong about cursed ramen, though none of others were familiar with the song. When pressed again by Jay, Cole suggested that the former had made up the folksong, though this did not deter him from singing. Unfortunately, Jay's song was accompanied by a small dance which consequentially disturbed the ninja's precarious position. As a massive piece of asphalt fell atop the ninja, Cole desperately activated his earth punch and struggled to keep it from falling atop himself and the others. Unfortunately, even with assistance from the other three, Cole felt his strength quickly slipping away. As his knees buckled, Cole apologized to his friends for being unable to save them, though Jay insisted in a defeated tone that it was alright. Just that moment, the ninja felt the piece of debris grow lighter and turned upwards in awe to see Nya standing above them in her new mech.

Once they resurfaced in Ninjago City, Cole immediately fell to his knees and muttered about how close they had come to death, learning from Nya that the Council of the Crystal King had destroyed the Monastery of Spinjitzu and that Harumi had returned from her seeming death all those years ago. Without time to lose, the ninja climbed aboard the mech and flew off to the old Samurai X Cave in the Sea of Sand. As they stepped into the cave, Cole greeted Wu and reminded him that while the Council of the Crystal King may have destroyed the Monastery, home was where one's family was, adding that everyone were here now and together again. However, Wu was quick to remind the team that Lloyd still remained missing, leading for them to begin brainstorming a way to rescue their captured leader.

The Coming of the King[]

Alongside Kai, Cole worked to construct one of the parts of a new vehicle. Believing that they had finished, Kai asked Cole to test it, only for the part to catch on fire. Shortly afterwards, Nya discovered that the signal to Lloyd's tracking device had been restored and he was located in Primeval's Eye, sparking Cole's attention as he, Kai, and Jay gathered around the monitor. Wu then warned that they would have to break the law again in order to steal back the impounded Destiny's Bounty to save Lloyd. Without hesitation, Cole agreed to partake in such action, even going as far as to add to Jay's comment about already being fugitives by encouraging Wu to become one too for Lloyd's sake.

Return to Primeval's Eye[]

Cole and his teammates scanned the Ninjago City Impound Lot from an adjacent rooftop. As they observed the two security guards, Cole became briefly distracted when one of them mentioned the word, "cake," and began to daydream about the pastry. This prompted Nya to snap him back into focus and Cole apologized. When the five infiltrated the impound lot, Cole retook his Dragon Cruiser and sped off to Primeval's Eye where he established a perimeter around the jungle to patrol alongside Kai and Jay before being ordered to retreat by Wu.

Crystastrophe[]

In their vehicles, Cole, Kai, and Jay were ordered to intercept something in the Farmers' village; Wu had neglected to give them specific details as to what they were to encounter, having only stated that they wouldn't miss it for their target was obvious. As they rode along, Cole commented on Wu's vague instructions, remarking that what may be obvious to Wu but not be obvious to them, though his voice trailed off as the ninja caught a glimpse of the Crystal Island floating in the skies above them. Staring ahead in disbelief, Cole corrected himself and admitted that Wu was right about their target being obvious.

As an army of Crystal Warriors rained down upon the village, Cole fought against them with his Dragon Cruiser, ramming into the stone creatures and firing at them with his vehicle's cannons. As he drove, Cole prioritized protecting the villagers, saving a pair from a squadron of Crystal Warriors and urging them to run for their lives when they stopped to admire his heroism. As the battle progressed, the ninja learned that their foes were made entirely out of Vengestone and strange crystals. Upon this discovery, Cole realized that the construction of this army had been the ultimate goal of the mysterious Vengestone Buyer.

After fighting for some time, and losing more and more ground, P.I.X.A.L. requested for the ninja to collect a piece of crystal for her to analyze, suggesting that after some study, she might be able to develop counter-measures for it. Jay obliged himself to satisfy P.I.X.A.L.'s request and approached one of the warriors he had rammed with his motorcycle, but Cole was quick to remind Jay not to touch the warriors, lest he be crystalized himself. As Jay hastily retreated, Cole tossed him his hammer, which Jay then used to break off a piece of a crystal spear. The fragment was collected by Kai and the ninja then retreated with their quarry.

A Lesson in Anger[]

On the retreat from the farmer's village, Cole stopped for a moment to provide aid to a pair of fleeing villagers. After knocking back the attacking squadron of Crystal Warriors with his cruiser's cannons, Cole let out a hearty laugh, mocking the warriors for their perceived invincibility. Unfortunately, Cole's boast proved to be premature, for the warriors soon rose again and counter-attacked with great ferocity. As the warriors now closed in on Cole, the earth ninja began to frantically jostle the controls of his cruiser, bemoaning the fact that his engine was now fried. Fortunately, aid would arrive just in time in the form of Jay and the Destiny's Bounty, buying enough time for Jay to safely tow Cole and his cruiser back to the Samurai X Cave.

After returning to the Samurai X Cave, Cole and the other ninja gathered around as Wu told them about his discovery of the Oni form and its potential ability to defeat the Crystal army. When Garmadon revealed his presence, Cole activated his earth punch in case Garmadon attempted to attack him or his friends. Luckily, there would be no need for hostilities, for Garmadon explained how he only intended to teach Lloyd to harness Oni form.

As Lloyd struggled to achieve Oni form, Cole and the others watched on with increasing discomfort as Garmadon began lambasting Lloyd for every perceived failure. After bracing several of Garmadon's insults, Cole and Jay finally intervened on Lloyd's behalf, with Cole pointing out in exasperation that Garmadon kept suggesting different techniques for Lloyd to follow as a means of achieving Oni form. Unfortunately, Garmadon ignored Cole's words and continued onwards with his brutal teaching style, further stoking the fires of tension between himself and the ninja. These tensions would finally come to a head when Garmadon blamed Wu's teachings for Lloyd's inability to achieve Oni form, greatly upsetting Cole who firmly stated that no one had a right to insult Master Wu. Even when Zane broke up the fight seconds later, Cole still refused to back away from his disdain for Garmadon and his teachings, stating that they needed to go out and confront the Crystal army head on rather than wasting anymore time on "nonsense."

Not long afterwards, P.I.X.A.L. revealed that she had made upgrades to the ninja's vehicles, thus enabling them to challenge the Crystal army head on. Amongst her instructions and warnings on the vehicular upgrades was for the ninja to be careful in utilizing their upgraded weapons systems so not to stress out their vehicles' engines. Cole however, brushed aside P.I.X.A.L.'s concerns, explaining that when it came down to risking burning out his cruiser's engine versus saving all of Ninjago City from the Overlord, he would always choose the former option as the more preferable one. And with that, Cole and the other three original ninja rushed to their vehicles and sped off towards Ninjago City.

Brave But Foolish[]

Arriving in the streets of Ninjago City, Cole eagerly activated his dragon cruiser's new upgrades in preparation for battle against the Crystal Warriors. After Kai's successful demonstration of the energy shielding's effectiveness against their foes, Cole joined in on the onslaught and helped to clear out a massive platoon of Crystal Warriors, shattering them instantly with his cruiser. Eventually, Cole's usage of his cruiser's shielding began overheating his engine and forced him to deactivate it while searching the city for more enemies alongside Kai.

As he drove alongside Kai, Cole saw in the corner of his eye that Kai's Golden Dragon Raider was suddenly rising into the air. After a quick, cursory glance to confirm this, Cole remarked that he was unaware that flight was part of Kai's raider's capabilities. This confused Kai who replied in panic that his vehicle was incapable of flight, causing Cole to take a longer look to realize that Kai was being lifted into the air by a Dragonide! In spite of Cole's shouts for Kai to blast off the creature, Kai's vehicle was incapable of firing behind it, and the Dragonide dropped Kai's raider atop of Cole's dragon cruiser. Surprised by the sudden collision, Cole lost control over his vehicle and crashed both his and Kai's vehicles not long after.

Safe Haven[]

Unconscious as a result of the crash, Cole was pulled from his damaged cruiser by Kai and briefly stirred, asking if they had won the battle. Unfortunately, Cole only remained semi-conscious and woozily gave away his and Kai's location when Pythor cheerily called out, "Come out wherever you are!" Fortunately, Skylor arrived just in time to back the two ninja up and copied Cole's powers of Earth alongside Kai's powers to erect a barrier separately them from Pythor and his Crystal Warriors.

As the trio began to leave the area, Cole fully woke up when Skylor revealed that their attack had failed and the Destiny's Bounty had crashed, snapping him back to reality as he listened in horror. Following Kai's lead, Cole and Skylor would make their way to Benny's Arcade, where they were startled by Jake. After receiving a transmission from Wu, containing a hint for survivors to seek out the Newspaper warehouse, Cole was overjoyed to hear his master's voice and commented briefly on his survival. He and the others would then make their way to the warehouse, with Kai leading the way. Upon arriving at the warehouse, Cole received a warm hug from Wu before running off to see what he could do to assist the Resistance.

Compatible[]

Cole and Nelson managed to successfully adjust the dispatch radio to the same frequency as the ninja's comms and celebrated their success. Cole then called Wu over to broadcast to their allies before taking over himself to excitedly let them know of their whereabouts. Before he could fully reveal their location, however, Wu cut him off to warn that their communications could be intercepted, leading for Cole to discreetly adjust himself by simply stating that they were located "Where the news never sleeps!"

Once the dispatch was completed, Wu asked Cole to reach out to Queen Vania to make good on her promise to back Cole up with the entire Army of Shintaro, though Cole noted they would need a much stronger signal in order to reach Shintaro. Although Vinny chimed in to offer the NGTV broadcast tower as a solution, Cole pointed out that it was on the other side of Ninjago City and they could not possibly make it there with the streets crawling with Crystal Warriors. The solution to this problem would soon reveal itself in the form of Racer Seven - who had since changed her name to the normal name of "Blazey H. Speed." Upon hearing Blazey's new name, Cole sarcastically muttered under his breath that her name was "really" normal before asking her what the "H" stood for.

Shortly thereafter, Cole, Vinny, and Blazey stepped out of the warehouse to Vinny's news van. Although Blazey eyed the vehicle with glittering eyes, Cole seemed more apprehensive and expressed concern about Blazey's ability to drive it, for it was nothing like the race car she drove in Prime Empire. Nonplussed, Blazey dismissed Cole's concerns and herded them all into the van before taking off at high speed.

Distress Calls[]

Alongside Vinny, Cole sat in the news van as Blazey drove them towards the NGTV News Center. During their travel, Cole and Vinny reacted to Blazey's reckless driving with horror, during which Cole sarcastically remarked that they must've broken a new land speed record. When the trio finally reached the top of the News Center, Cole began to broadcast his message to Vania, reminding her of the time she told him that if he ever needed help, she would bring the entire Army of Shintaro to his aid. Although Cole admitted she probably meant her words in a metaphorical sense, he stated he quite literally needed the entire Army of Shintaro in order to fight back against the Overlord and his Crystal Army. Unfortunately, Cole's broadcast would be cut short thanks to the arrival of several Dragonides, forcing him and his allies to retreat into the news center. When Cole asked Vinny if the latter thought the message was transmitted prior to the destruction of the transmission tower, he learned to his dismay that it most likely failed to transmit. Cole then reported his presumed failure to Wu and returned to the hideout with his allies.

An Issue of Trust[]

Arriving outside the Newspaper warehouse, Cole was reunited with his allies and watched as Kai shared a hug with P.I.X.A.L. Shortly thereafter, he and the others were ushered inside by Wu who spoke to them about his discovery of Dragon Form. Cole and the others then attempted to perform the art, but were unsuccessful.
