After many unsuccessful attempts, Cole admitted that Garmadon may have been right to suggest that Quanish was a fool, prompting Wu to angrily hurl the scroll to the ground in frustration and storm off. As it drifted to the ground, the sheet of paper gently landed beside Cole with one of its corners folding upon itself. Cole took note of this and the iconography present on the folded edge and picked up the scroll, gasping as he realized that the scroll was meant to be folded.

Wu then read aloud the transcription found on the folded scroll and questioned the meaning of its riddle, but time had run out; Cole's earlier eagerness to hear his allies' voices had bitten back, and the Crystal army was now rapidly approaching the warehouse after intercepting his transmission! When Kai emphasized that they had to move the civilians taking shelter in the warehouse to safety, Cole asked how they could possibly do that, for the streets were crawling with Crystal Warriors. Nevertheless, Cole expressed willingness to assist Lloyd and Garmadon in taking the fight directly to the Crystal King, but was shot down by Wu who stated that Cole and the other ninja were needed on the ground to draw attention away from Lloyd and his father.

In preparation for the final battle, Cole secured the alleyways surrounding the warehouse, barricading and sealing them off by raising walls of stone. Once this was completed, Cole took position in front of the warehouse with his allies and charged into battle against the Crystal army as the final battle begun.

Dragon Form[]

Cole swung his baseball bat to deflect the blasts from the Crystal Warriors. As he readied his Earth Punch, he realized that his powers were being suppressed due to the Crystal Warriors closing in on him. The Dragonides had successfully crystallized Ultra Violet, Killow, and Ronin, and the crystal army had cornered Cole and his allies in the warehouse. Suddenly, a roar echoed through the air, and Cole understood that Vania and the Shintarans had received his message. The Keepers, Benthomaar, Glutinous, the Maaray Guards, the Hypnobrai, the Red Visors, the Whack Rats, along with their friends and families, including Lou, arrived to support the Resistance. Recalling the strength of unity foretold in the Dragon Form scroll, Cole, Jay, Kai, and Zane unlocked their Dragon Forms. The ninja engaged in battle against the crystal army, with Cole facing off against Vangelis.

Vangelis chased Cole on his Dragonide, fueled by a fierce desire for revenge. Cole feigned ignorance, asking Vangelis to explain what he had supposedly done wrong. Vangelis accused Cole of usurping his throne and turning his own people, including Vania, against him. In a playful tone, Cole suggested that Vangelis was responsible for his own troubles. Vangelis, furious, dismissed Cole's claims, asserting that he had the Dragonide ready to capture him. He revealed that the Overlord wanted Cole alive, but with the Overlord absent, Vangelis intended to finish Cole off himself. Just as Vangelis prepared to strike with the Scythe of Destruction, Adam intervened, ensnaring Vangelis in webs. Cole thanked Vania and the Upply for their timely assistance. He managed to reclaim the scythe, but it began to corrupt him. Zane advised Cole to channel his elemental powers into the Scythe. Following this advice, Cole successfully transformed the scythe back into the Scythe of Quakes and used it to trap Vangelis in a sinkhole.

After the purification of all the Golden Weapons, the Crystal Warriors and the Dragonides started to lose their power. The Resistance took decisive action, eliminating all the stone creatures, effectively dismantling the crystal army. The ninja rejoiced in their victory, and Cole embraced Vania in a hug. However, Aspheera warned them that soon Cole and the others would fall under the Overlord's corruption, as their elemental powers would be seized. As the Crystal Island approached, Cole and the Resistance stood watch. Wu realized that the Overlord wanted to corrupt the Elements of Creation so he could destroy the Balance. However, the Overlord as moments away from winning.

Roots[]

Wu informed the ninja that in order to stop the Overlord from destroying the Balance, they needed to combine their Golden Weapons, which would cause their Elemental Powers to be expelled and would return to their original forms. Cole disagreed, arguing that without their powers and weapons, they would be defenseless. Wu countered by stating that they had already lost and their only hope was to prevent the Elements of Creation from falling into the hands of the Overlord. Zane agreed with Wu's plan. The ninja gathered on the rooftop of the newspaper warehouse and, with a final salute, united their Golden Weapons, resulting in the destruction and the release of their Elemental Powers. However, the Overlord managed to corrupt all of Ninjago, including Cole.

After Lloyd's victory over the Overlord, Cole noticed the Golden Ultra Dragon and asked the other ninja where it came from. As Lloyd approached, Cole saw Harumi and eyed her suspiciously. However, Lloyd assured them that Harumi was on their side. The group then approached the dragon, with Cole petting the Earth Dragon's head. As the dragon began to fade away, Cole remarked on its disappearance, and Wu explained that the Elemental Powers were returning to their origins. Cole asked Wu what their next move was, and Wu replied that they would rebuild as they always did. Cole then turned to speak with Misako.

A week passed, and Cole actively participated in the reconstruction of the Monastery of Spinjitzu. As he strolled through the ongoing work, he encountered the Upply and joined up with them. Plundar appeared behind Cole, and they warmly embraced each other.

Quest for the Lost Powers

Quest for the Lost Powers[]

Following the Ninja's victory during the Final prophecy of Quanish the Elder, Cole left the team in search of a new purpose. Specifically, he sought to do something that could better connect him with his former element, so he thought about trying his hand at farming, joining a farm owned by Sally-Bob. During his time there, Cole learned of the farmers' troubles with their greedy neighbor, Takanagi, who owned all of the surrounding land and had repeatedly tried to buy out the farmers. When those offers were refused, Takanagi resorted to harassment, aiming to drive them off their lands. Upon hearing this, Cole vowed to serve as the farm's protector for as long as he would be needed.

One day, Lou came to the farm to visit his son. At the time, Cole was trying to coax Henry, Sally-Bob's yak, into pulling a plow to till the fields and eventually managed to get it done just before his father greeted him. Surprised to see his father, Cole hugged him and explained his reasoning for picking up farming before introducing him to some of the other farmers. At nightfall, Cole and his father retreated to the barn to spend their night. However, they would be awoken by Henry, who was surprisingly imitating the sounds of a rooster. Although Lou, being a newcomer, was confused as to the significance of this call, Cole explained that Henry only made such noises under two circumstances: when it was nearly morning, or when they were under attack. And it was still several hours before daybreak, meaning only one thing.

After ordering his father to stay back, Cole stepped out of the barn and approached the large hill that separated Sally-Bob's property from Takanagi's. At the top of the hill stood a platoon of modified tractors driven by the latter's men; without a doubt, another raid was in store. Unfortunately, since Cole no longer possessed his elemental power of Earth, all he was able to do was to attack with bursts of Spinjitzu and hope for the best. Unfortunately, that proved to be insufficient at repelling the advancing forces, and Cole was quickly overwhelmed, unable to do anything except watch on sadly as the goons tore apart Sally-Bob's fields before retreating. When Lou checked in on his son, Cole downplayed his own injuries, explaining that he was more concerned about the security of the farm than himself.

As the hours ticked by, Cole admitted to his father that he sometimes felt powerless now that he no longer possessed his elemental powers, and wondered if his late mother had ever felt like this before. Lou affirmed this and relayed a story to his son dating back to when Cole was only a few years old. Following the story, Cole helped to train Sally-Bob and her farmers in the arts of self defense as they prepared for Takanagi's next attack. The next evening, Takanagi himself arrived to fully take the farm by force. Although the man boasted of great strength and power, his forces were quickly overwhelmed and routed by the farmers, thanks to Cole's training. Infuriated by this outcome, Takanagi mounted his modified harvester and spend on towards the farmers themselves. As Cole watched the farmers bravely stand their ground, refusing to budge an inch, Cole felt a familiar feeling of strength return to him. Commanding the earth itself, Cole raised up massive pillars of dirt and stone from beneath Takanagi, striking the businessman's harvester off the ground and hurling him beyond the horizon. The day had been saved.

Following this battle, Cole and his father spent some more time on the farm to help repair and restore the damages that had been inflicted upon it by Takanagi. The day eventually came however when both father and son departed the farm and went their separate ways. As he left, Cole promised Sally-Bob that he would return to help out during the harvest, and also encouraged her to call him and the other Ninja should they ever need help again. With a final goodbye to Henry, Cole and his father left Sally-Bob's farm behind, with Cole returning to the Monastery of Spinjitzu to rejoin his friends.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

Cole was outside the Monastery with the rest of the ninja when the Merge began. To rescue as many citizens as possible, Cole and the others boarded the Destiny's Bounty and set off towards Ninjago City. Unfortunately, their proximity to the Merge caused Cole to become separated from the group once the Merge was completed.[13][14] He found himself stranded in the Land of Lost Things, a desolate valley within Imperium where forgotten items and people ended up. Cole was taken in by a group of runaways known as the Finders, who were in constant danger due to the presence of the Hoarder. In order to protect the Finders, who were unable to leave the valley due to being forgotten, Cole made the decision to remain in the Land of Lost Things. As time passed, Cole discovered a newfound ability to encase himself in stone, forming an Elemental Golem. However, he attributed this ability to a power-up granted by Geo, the Elemental Master of Fusion, rather than his own inherent capabilities.[15]

They Call It Doom[]

In his Elemental Golem form, Cole arrived to shield Fritz and Spitz from what he believed were potential threats - Nya, Sora, and Riyu. In his misguided attempt to safeguard the children, Cole engaged in a battle with the trio. However, as Nya used Spinjitzu, Cole recognized Nya, realizing his error in perceiving her as an adversary.

Land of Lost Things[]

Sora's mention of the Kingdom of Shintaro caught Cole off guard, causing his Elemental Golem to break apart. Surprised, Cole commented on how someone must have done their research on him. Sora revealed that her best friend, Arin, was a fan of the ninja and even styled his hair like Zane's. Cole hoped that Sora was joking, but she confirmed that it was true but added that Arin never mentioned Cole encasing himself in an Elemental Golem. Admitting that it was a new development, Cole turned to Nya and asked if she has found anyone else. Nya revealed that they haven't located Jay, Master Wu, and P.I.X.A.L. yet. As he was introduced to Sora and Riyu, Cole acknowledged that he has missed a lot and explained that news was scarce in the Land of Lost Things. Curious, Nya asks if the valley was where Cole woke up after the Merge, and Cole confirmed, mentioning that he had no idea where he was until the Finders took him in. Cole further confirmed that the Land of Lost Things was indeed real and that lost things can come from any realm other than Imperium. Intrigued by the yellow Dragon Core, Cole learned that it was an artifact that could save the Merged Realms. Reflecting on the mission of saving the world, Cole remarked that it was comforting to know that some things never changed. However, their conversation was abruptly interrupted by the sudden attack of the Hoarder, who threw a car at them. The Hoarder chased Cole, the ninja, and the Finders, but Cole tried to divert its attention by throwing a container at it. Unfortunately, it didn't work. Nya asked Cole where the Hoarder came from, but he didn't know either. He explained that the Hoarder had been around for as long as he could remember. To escape from the Hoarder, Cole suggested that they go inside the giant noodle cup, where they reunited with Geo.

Concerned, Geo asked Cole if he was alright, to which Cole reassured him that he was fine. Nya questioned the need for hiding, stating that they should have no trouble dealing with the Hoarder. Cole explained that every time they've confronted it directly, it only grows stronger and more dangerous. Geo decided to create a diversion to buy them some time, urging Cole to go. Cole activated his powers, preparing to dig a tunnel. However, he heard screaming that he attributed to the earth itself. Despite this, Cole insisted that they must press on and lead the way into the tunnel. Emerging from the tunnel at a safe distance, they observe the Hoarder attacking a noodle cup. Nya was concerned for Geo's safety, but Cole informed her just to wait for what happens next. Geo, utilizing his Elemental Powers, fused the noodle cup with the Hoarder's hand. Cole and the rest of the group ride Jiro and Zanth to the Rookery, marveling at the sculptures Geo made along the way. Cole then explained Geo was the Elemental Master of Fusion, allowing him to forge unbreakable bonds between objects. Sora related to the concept of making art, sharing her own experience of repurposing old items to create new technology. Cole asked about Sora's specific Elemental Power, to which she hesitantly responded that it was Technology, but mentioned her belief that it came from Riyu. Cole added that the origin of one's power may not be as important as how it was used for the greater good. Nya then mentioned the Merge, which had brought about new Elemental Powers like Technology and Fusion. Cole pondered the fact of the creation of new Elemental Powers due to the realms being united. Cole was asked about the trigger for his Elemental Golem. Before he can respond, their conversation was interrupted by the roar of the Hoarder.

Upon entering inside the Rookery, Cole instructed Fritz, Spitz, and Bonzle to prepare a meal for Nya and Sora. Nya asked Cole about the Finders and their connection to the Land of Lost Things. Cole confirmed Nya's suspicions and proceeded to explain that the Finders were indeed denizens who became lost and forgotten, eventually ending up in the Land of Lost Things after running away from their homes. As they engaged in conversation, their attention was suddenly drawn to what was keeping the Hoarder away. Cole revealed that it was a noise-making machine, which had been created long before he and the Finders stumbled upon it. Cole admitted that it was the most advanced machine he had ever encountered, but playfully added that Zane should be kept in the dark about his opinion. Intrigued by its power source, Nya's curiosity led Cole to open the door to the machine, revealing the yellow Dragon Core. Nya's attempt to take the Yellow Dragon Core was met with resistance from Cole, who questioned her actions. However, Nya reminded Cole of their mission to save the world and emphasized the importance of the Core in achieving that goal. Cole explained that the machine was necessary to keep the Hoarder at bay and without it would put them in danger. Nya suggested taking Cole and the Finders with them, as all three Dragon Cores are needed to prevent the world from destruction. However, Geo informed them that those who were forgotten couldn't leave the Land of Lost Things due to a mysterious fog. Sora proposed a different approach, suggesting that they find a new power source to operate the machine instead of directly confronting the Hoarder. With her knowledge of Imperium tech and Riyu's dragon power, she believed she can reconfigure the machine to work with a different power source. She handed Nya and Cole a list of required parts to proceed with her plan.

While Cole and Nya were looking for parts, Nya noticed the remains of a portal gate. Curious, she asked Cole where he had found it. Cole replied that Geo had discovered it and asked what a portal gate was. Nya was surprised by Cole's lack of knowledge and realized that they had a lot to catch up on with each other. Soon, they were searching for an influx stabilizer that Sora urgently needs. Cole admitted his lack of understanding about the device, feeling out of his depth. As they continue their search, they are abruptly interrupted by the alarming sight of Imperium Drones attacking Jiro. Nya was concerned about how Beatrix could have known of their presence. Cole asks about Beatrix, but Nya insists that there was no time for explanations. Their attention was diverted when they noticed the Hoarder's arrival, with Cole noticing its newly rebuilt hand. Cole decided to take on the Hoarder, while Nya focused on fighting the drones. As the battle went on, Nya suggested that Cole should utilize his Elemental Golem. However, Cole revealed that he can only access this power when Geo boosts him with with Fusion. Nya was surprised at the revelation, questioning why Cole hadn't mentioned it earlier. Cole explains that they have a lot to catch up on, and Nya said that it was unusual for people to share Elemental Powers in such a way. Cole brought up Sora and Riyu as examples. However, Nya mentioned that fact that they're simply just Sora's powers. Before they can delve further into the discussion, Jiro intervened, grabbing Cole and Nya and carrying them away to safety.

Cole managed to catch Geo just as he was about to fall. Cole greeted Geo with a playful remark, being surprise at their unexpected encounter. Nya quickly informed them of the urgent task at hand, emphasizing the need to retrieve the Dragon Core from LaRow. However, the Hoarder returned, as the Rookery no longer had the core. Cole reassured Geo that they were not defenseless, reminding him of the ninja's skills. He instructed Nya to pursue LaRow while focused on evacuating the other Finders from the Rookery to safety. Cole then turned to Geo, urging him to empower him. However, Geo hesitated, causing Cole to become impatient. Despite the setback, Geo seemingly transfer his powers to Cole, and Cole used his Elemental Golem form and charged towards the Hoarder. Zanth managed to tear off a piece of the Hoarder, earning praise from Cole for her bravery. Unfortunately, the Hoarder retaliated by seizing Zanth and forcefully slamming her onto Cole, causing his Elemental Golem form to be break apart. Sora used her Elemental Powers to dismantle the Hoarder, revealing that the Hoarder was just a magnetic organism named Sweeper. Geo commended Sora for saving them all, to which Sora acknowledged that she couldn't have accomplished it without receiving a power boost from Riyu. Cole added that he also couldn't have held off Sweeper without Geo's Elemental Powers. However, Geo revealed that he doesn't actually possess enhance Cole's powers. Confused, Cole mentioned his reliance on Geo's assistance, but Geo explained that his powers don't affect living beings. Cole realized that it had been his own abilities all along and acknowledged that he needed Geo to help him realize his true potential in his Elemental Golem.

Absolute Power[]

Cole, Nya, and Sora discussed their plans on how to enter Imperium, which would be hard because of the energy barrier. Sora contemplated the idea of building armor for Jiro, which would enhance his natural energy and enable him to break through the energy barrier. Riyu provides Sora with a power boost, and she combines various parts using her elemental powers. After completing the armor, Sora attaches it to Jiro, while Cole observes that Jiro liked it. As the ninja prepared to leave, Cole told Nya how he had previously mentioned hearing the ground screaming, informing that the previous night he heard a voice calling out to him from the edge of the valley. Nya immediately recognized it as Wu's voice, as she had once followed it in the Cloud Kingdom, leading her to Kai and ultimately saving Lloyd and the others. Cole revealed that Master Wu was calling him to follow. Nya encouraged him to go, emphasizing that if he heard Master Wu's voice, he should always follow. Cole expressed his gratitude and determination, stating that his journey would now take him elsewhere. As Nya and Sora departed on their dragons, the golden sphere appeared behind Cole, calling his name. Intrigued, Cole chased after it.

Prior to The Elemental Mechs

Prior to The Elemental Mechs[]

At some point, Cole took a break from his pursuit of the golden sphere and returned to the monastery and reunited with the other ninja, eventually learning that many dangerous artifacts, including Chronosteel, were being smuggled somewhere and immediately went to warn them.

What the Mech?[]

Cole arrives, having ridden an Earth Dragon, only to crash into Kai, Sora, and Lloyd's other student Arin, who were on Kai's Super Awesome Slide Course while Lloyd was away before telling him the reason for his return. Arin instantly knew where the Chronosteel would be in Kreel's Junkyard, who boasted about it through advertisements.

The Mech Master[]

Cole walked with Kai, Sora, Arin, Riyu, and Nya towards the Mech Master 5000’s stands, telling Arin about Chef Grab-Barg's Creme de Imperium pies.

Cole and the other ninja were at the stands watching the Mech Master Race 5000 begin when the Mechanic attacked and took over the mechs of the racers. Cole, Sora, and Kai then showed up in their mechs, blocking the Mechanic's path. The Mechanic then sent one of the mechs to crash into the three mechs, breaking all three and shattering the barrier. As the Mechanic raced away, Cole told Sora to chase the Mechanic while he and Kai took on the other mechs.

As Sora put her mech back together with mismatched limbs from the other mechs and chased the Mechanic, Cole and Kai put their own mechs back together, also with mismatched limbs.

When one of the Mechanic's mechs moved towards his mech, Cole used an arm that was originally from Kai's mech to shoot fire, knocking it down. Kai then used an arm originally from Cole's mech to use the element of Earth to knock the other mech down. When both mechs charged at them again, Cole and Kai used each other's powers to knock them down, with both ninja remarking the same thing at the same time afterwards.

After Sora defeated the Mechanic, Cole and the other ninja caught up to her in their mechs.

Later, Cole and the other ninja walked down the racetrack.

Prior to Dragons Rising, Season 2

Prior to Dragons Rising, Season 2[]

Following the noodle cook-off, Cole left Ninjago to continue his mission. Once he successfully accomplished his task, Cole journeyed towards the Land of Lost Things to reunite with the Finders.[16]

Dragons Rising, Season 2

Dragons Rising, Season 2[]

Force From the East[]

Cole learned that the Wolf Mask Warriors were after Bonzle for unknown reasons. Cole swiftly launched an attack to assist the Finders in rescuing Bonzle from the clutches of the Wolf Mask Warriors, successfully defeating them and securing Bonzle's safety. Despite his victory, Cole warned the Finders to take cover, anticipating the arrival of more Wolf Mask Warriors seeking to capture Bonzle. Using his Earth powers, Cole created a shelter to shield the Finders from any further attempts by the Wolf Mask Warriors to capture Bonzle. Following the creation of the shelter, Cole conversed with the Finders, who were relieved at his return and shared that they had missed him. Cole, pleased to have arrived in time to help, inquired about the situation in the Cloud Kingdom. Despite Cole's efforts in creating a shelter, the Wolf Mask Warriors began to breach it, prompting Geo to use his powers to reinforce the barrier and prevent them from reaching Bonzle. Unfortunately Geo's efforts were in a vain, as Ras in the Cloud Kingdom commanded two of Writers of Destiny to use the Mallet of Shattering on the Gong of Shattering the transforming Wolf Mask Warriors at the Land of Lost Things into Wolf Mask Claw Warriors and being able to continue breach through the shelter. Cole stumbled upon a portal gate nearby and decided to reconstruct it in order to escape the Wolf Mask Claw Warriors with the help of the Finders. Once the gate was successfully rebuilt, Cole and the Finders ventured through it and found themselves back in Ninjago, astonished by the turn of events. Upon encountering Zane and Alfonzo Frohicky, Cole was puzzled by Zane's frog man doll. Subsequently, Cole sought Zane's assistance in defeating the Wolf Mask Claw Warriors.

The Spell at the Waterfall[]

To Mysterium[]

This section is a stub. You can help expand this section by adding some information.


Fugitives From Madness[]

As Cole and the others stepped into the monastery, they quickly realized that this place was not the Monastery of Spinjitzu. Cole noticed that the interior was quite different compared to the Monastery of Spinjitzu. He began to wonder if the Monastery of Mysterium was merely an illusion, but Zane assured him that it was indeed real. While exploring, Cole noticed a crack in the wall shaped like a noodle bowl, which reminded him of the one he and Jay had accidentally created during an argument over a video game controller. He felt a pang of nostalgia and missed Jay, pondering where he might be after the Merge. Just then, the yellow orb appeared and floated into the monastery, capturing Cole's attention. He turned to Zane for answers, but Zane could only share that they had encountered the orb before without much detail. Moments later, the Sorceress revealed herself as Gandalaria, explaining that the yellow orb was named Spirte. Gandalaria claimed that the arrival of Cole and his friends would bring significant changes, and she began asking for slugs. This left Cole puzzled until he realized she was actually waiting for the Slug Merchants, not the ninja. Gandalaria then spotted Bonzle and was taken aback, recognizing her from a spell she had cast long ago.

Cole concentrated on their current mission and addressed Gandalaria as Sorceress. However, Gandalaria preferred to be called by her true name. Despite her request, Cole continued to use the title Sorceress, finding it difficult to pronounce Gandalaria. He warned her about the urgent need to protect Bonzle from Ras and the Wolf Clan, explaining that Ras aimed to release the Forbidden Five. Cole and Zane shared their concerns, revealing that Ras had discovered how to conduct the Ritual of the Blood Moon, which was approaching quickly. Cole emphasized the danger, stating that if the Forbidden Five were freed, they could dominate all the Merged Realms. Gandalaria countered this idea, asserting that the Forbidden Five would not conquer but rather destroy the Merged Realms. She suggested they venture into the Wyldness to find an item that could protect Bonzle, and Cole proposed they travel there on Jiro. Their discussion was abruptly interrupted by a knock at the door. Initially, Cole feared it was the Wolf Clan, but they soon realized it was the Administration Agents, who were demanding Zane's return. Cole was shocked to learn that Zane had previously been kidnapped by the Administration Agents and had been rescued by Lloyd and Arin.

The Blood Moon had just risen when Zane an offer to surrender himself. Roderick, however, pointed out that Zane, as a Nindroid, was viewed as mere machinery and not a true living being. If Zane chose to give himself up, would be taken to the Department of Demolitions, which Cole quickly noted would effectively mean Zane's death. Roderick dismissed Cole's concerns, arguing that Zane's demise was insignificant compared to that of a human. He also warned that anyone who helped Zane would face severe consequences, including termination by the Administration Agents, putting Cole and the others at risk. Annoyed, Cole urged his friends to escape on Jiro, but the Administration Agents had already captured Jiro. Cole demanded Jiro's release, but Roderick merely suggested they could discuss it while heading to the incinerator. As the Administration Agents prepared to invade the Monastery of Mysterium, Zane cleverly stalled them by claiming they needed to complete paperwork, which initially confused Cole. While the agents were distracted with the forms, Zane attempted to take the blame for their predicament, but Cole insisted they were all in this together. Meanwhile, Gandalaria sent Bonzle to hide in the passages, guided by Sprite, while she, Cole, and Zane prepared to confront the Administration Agents, using Gandalaria's crystal ball for support. Cole initially thought Gandalaria's crystal ball would be unexciting until she clarified that it was not an ordinary one. Just then, the Administration Agents broke through the walls, prompting Cole to summon his Elemental Earth Mech to battle them alongside the Master Mechs.

Prior to Enter the City of Temples[]

They Gather for the Feast[]

Inside the Maze[]

Cole was exploring the City of Temples when he ran into Geo, who had received his invitation after Cole had left. They ventured together and discovered a Titan Mech, likely belonging to a past Elemental Master of Earth—Cole wondered if it might have been his mother's.

Cole was in the Temple City quarters when Lloyd told everyone it was time to go to the game plaza. However since Roby refused to tell who everyone is competing against until the event itself annoyed the Ninja. Cole met with the ninja as they agreed to only use Rising Dragon to counter Shatterspin. After Zane lost to Zur, Cole was surprise to see Nya's opponent was Jay. His surprise deepened as he saw his old friend on Ras’ team, treating Nya as if she were a stranger. Cole couldn’t believe it, insisting that Jay would never forget Nya or any of them. He even tried to convince himself that Ras had somehow created a fake Jay with a loser wearing a Jay wig, but Lloyd reminded him that none of them knew what had happened to Jay after his disappearance in the Merge. Cole nervously watched as Jay attacked Nya and even used a Wolf Mask to shatter his goodness. Although Nya won, Cole and the others realized Jay had been lost to evil. When Nya tried to comfort him, Jay expressed nothing but hatred for Nya, leaving Cole and the others shaken by the deep change in their friend.

United We Fall[]

After Nya’s match with Jay, Cole and the others (minus Wyldfyre) headed to the Wolf Clan quarters, determined to confront them and demand Jay's return. Standing firmly by Nya's side, Cole helped her confront Ras, demanding that he undo whatever he had done to Jay. But Ras coldly informed them that Jay was already gone—he had sent him away for his failure. When Nya wanted to go after Jay and save him, Cole reminded her that Ras was playing them: the only reason he sent Jay off was so he could get rid of the ninja should they go after him. Nya countered that they will go after him because Jay needed them; not only had Jay lost his memories, but he also used the Gong of Shattering and they would need to help Jay heal his inner goodness. But Lloyd and Zane backed Cole up and told her that the Tournament of Sources is a threat to the Merged Lands and if it is destroyed then Jay will never be saved.

Truth and Lies[]

Cole charged ahead in the Combo Vehicle, weaving through the track with relentless focus. As the four ninjas raced through the tunnel, they were suddenly confronted by a massive cave-in, blocking their path with no escape. Without missing a beat, Sora sprang into action, merging all four vehicles into one unstoppable machine. The newly combined vehicle plowed through the rubble effortlessly, clearing the path. With a burst of acceleration, they passed the Pace Dragon, surging ahead and crossing the finish line in first place. Roby’s voice echoed over the loudspeaker, announcing that the ninjas had secured their spot in the Tournament of the Sources.

Later, Cole watched as Euphrasia and Zeatrix clashed fiercely on floating platforms. Then, during the match between Nokt and Tox, Cole rushed to help when Nokt severely injured Tox, assisting her onto a stretcher.

When Roby called Cole and Frak as the next competitors, Cole was caught off guard to see Arin standing next to Frak, looking out of place. Facing off against Frak, Cole couldn't help but be perplexed by Frak's overenthusiastic fanboy attitude. As the two climbed the obstacle, Cole realized it seemed to be designed for Frak’s abilities, not his own. Frak rang the bell first, forcing Cole to surrender his Earth power to him. After the match, Cole confided in Lloyd, noting how the competition felt rigged against them. Lloyd agreed, his eyes narrowing suspiciously at Roby and Bleckt.

During Nya’s match with Nokt, Cole tried to calm Wyldfyre, but her defiant response—saying her anger helped her stay focused—only frustrated him more. As Nya battled Nokt, Cole kept a watchful eye on Wyldfyre, making sure she didn’t lose control of her emotions. Later Cole and the other Ninja watched Sora and Cinder's fight.

Later at night, Cole was asleep when a yellow orb flew into the ninja's quarters. The sudden appearance of the orb roused Cole from his sleep, prompting him to pursue it outside. Although he had encountered the orb on previous occasions, he was unable to identify it, leaving him to ponder its nature once again. Cole expressed to the orb his current lack of powers, stating that if he were able, he would create an earth bridge to follow it. In response, the orb illuminated a path through the fog, revealing the existence of another monastery nearby.

The Sword Shatters[]

Lloyd woke everybody up for training. Later Cole told Zane about the mysterious monastery the yellow orb showed him last night. Zane suggested that instead of wondering why he was guided to that monastery, he think about how can he get there. Walking into their quarters, they saw Arin doing some detective work. Cole was surprised that Ras had let Arin and Riyu go and expressed skepticism that Ras might not have been behind the attack on the Matriarch dragon. The group discussed the possible suspects, with Cole pointing out that Zeatrix was oddly confident about winning and suggested that she might know something about the horns. When Arin brought up the mysterious symbol he found, Cole suggested for Arin go to the Temple City Museum, as it contained all kinds of ancient art and writing. As Arin left, Cole noticed his cold demeanor towards Sora, which Zane commented as registering with high levels of cringe.

At the Games Plaza, Sora asked Lloyd, Zane and Cole where Riyu went. Cole said he probably went with Nya when he got distracted by the food. When Roby announced that Frak and Zur will be the next competitors, Frak turned to Cole, curious about his newfound Earth powers. In response, Cole offered some advice, specifically suggesting for Frak to focus on reaching down instead of up, a different motion than using his Quake ability. Sora, having overheard, questioned Cole as to why he was helping Frak, given that the latter was on Ras' team. In response, Cole reminded her that they couldn't let their history with Ras interfere with their decisions.

With the bell rung by Bleckt, the match began. When Zur froze Frak in place and began to sink him down, Cole’s voice rang out, reminding Frak to tap into his Earth power like they’d discussed. Frak followed the advice and successfully used the power to lift himself back up, ultimately defeating Zur. Roby then transfered Zur's Elemental Powers to Frak, signaling his victory. From the sidelines, Ras reprimanded Frak for taking advice from Cole, angrily growling that only he was Frak's master and no one else. Cole, who had been watching from a distance, gave Frak a sympathetic glance.

Cole later watched Lloyd's fight with Zeatrix. During the match, Cole questioned why Lloyd didn't knock her down and realized he was looking for the sword from his visions. After Lloyd was struck by Zeatrix, Cole went to help him.

Clues and Suspects[]

Cole is healing Lloyd when Roby comes in to transfer Zeatrix's powers to Lloyd, as he is the victory of the match. Cole continues tending to Lloyd’s injuries, but his attention is diverted when he overhears Arin and Sora discussing the Dragon Crowns and their connection to the Monastery. Cole corrects Arin saying the Spinjitzu Monastery but another Monastery.

Later, Cole takes Arin to the Monastery and shows him the yellow orb, along with some of their friends, as they begin brainstorming ways to cross over to the other side. In a bold move, Cole borrows his mother’s old mech and uses it to construct an Earth bridge, helping them cross. Upon reaching the Monastery, the four orbs come together, merging to form the image of Master Wu.

The Final Game[]

Arin and Cole are left wondering if Master Wu's ghost is real. They follow the apparition inside when it enter the Monastery of Gates, The Monastery is filled with sixteen gateways. Cole counts them and thinks each gateway leading to a different realm. Suddenly, Wu's ghost reappears before them. Cole asked if it is Master Wu which the ghost nods. Cole express his concern with what happened to him after the Merge, thinking he is departed but the ghost remains silent but gestures upward, pointing to a circle of Dragon Horns suspended from the ceiling. Arin ask what Ras told him if he caused the Merge is real but Cole quickly dismisses the idea, saying "Ras is a liar" and "Master Wu would never do such a thing." But Arin insists and the ghost looks back at them, and answers, "Yes." Before they can react, the ghost vanishes, passing through one of the sixteen gates and disappearing into the unknown realms. Cole was shock by this revelation saying "that can't be right."

Elements of Betrayal[]

Operating the Elemental Earth Mech, Cole faced a challenging task as he attempted to detach the Crowns of Horns from the ceiling. Just then, Zane and Arin arrived, alerting him that the tournament was approaching its end, and if Ras emerged victorious, he would use the horns to access the Source Dragons. In a turn of events, a loud crash echoed through the monastery as Cole punched through the ceiling, creating a new opening. To everyone's surprise, Nya and Riyu stepped through the gap. Nya shared that they had discovered a way to communicate with Kai using Dragon Ivory, a breakthrough that could potentially help in rescuing both Kai and Bonzle, though it came with the risk of awakening the Forbidden Five. At that moment, Nokt and Jordana arrived. Cole and the group confronted them, only to find out that the pair had betrayed Ras. Nokt advanced towards the Monastery of Gates, determined to free the remaining members of the Forbidden Five. Meanwhile, Jordana confronted Cole, Zane, and Nya. To their surprise, they observed Jordana acting strangely, soon realizing that she had been possessed by Rox since the Ritual of the Blood Moon. In a swift move, Rox cast a static spell that rendered Cole, Zane, and Nya immobile. As Rox taunted the ensnared ninja, Nokt succeeded in liberating the Forbidden Five, which led to Rox being forcefully expelled from Jordana. Jordana managed to break the paralysis affecting Cole and the others. Cole attempted to repair the damaged rock bridge but discovered that the Elemental Earth Mech had depleted its Elemental Energy. Fortunately, Lloyd, Sora, and Wyldfyre rejoined Cole and the group. Utilizing the glider from the Ninja Team Combo Vehicle, Cole successfully maneuvered the Elemental Earth Mech across to the Monastery of Gates, confronted the Forbidden Five. Cole managed to deflect an energy blast from Nokt. He pressed forward, continuing to attack Nokt, but during the fight, he lost the mech's sword. In his attempt to save Zane, Cole found himself trapped underneath the mech. Just when things seemed hopeless, Roby activated the Elemental Cup, stripping Nokt of the powers he had stolen and returning them to their rightful owners—Cole included, who regained his Earth power.

Cole and the others cornered Nokt, who managed to escape alongside the remaining members of the Forbidden Five by using a portal gate that led to the Cloud Kingdom, taking Ras as a hostage in the process. Arin, determined to reduce Ras, followed closely behind, but upon his arrival, Cole and the others witnessed the Forbidden Five destroy the gate, triggering a massive explosion that transported everyone who entered to an entirely different Merged Land. In the aftermath, Cole, Zane, Wyldfyre, and Riyu took a moment to celebrate their reunion with Kai, playfully dogpiling. Cole expressed his joy at having Bonzle back and remarked on the impressive nature of their entrance.

The ninja then proceeded to the Games Plaza, where they participated in the victory ceremony, culminating in Roby's official declaration of Sora as the new Champion of the Sources. After the festivities, the ninja prepared to head back to the Monastery of Spinjitzu, while Cole took the opportunity to consult with the Writers of Destiny regarding Arin's current location. Unfortunately, he discovered that no one had emerged from their side of the portal gate. Upon returning to the monastery, Cole shared this troubling news with Zane, who confessed that he had feared this outcome.

Relationships

These are the relationships of the Earth Ninja, Cole.

Family

Family[]

Lou[]

“There's something I've been wanting to tell you. All these years, I haven't been training to be a singer or a dancer. I found something new that I'm really good at. Dad. . . I'm a ninja. And the truth is, if we don't steal that Fangblade—I mean, Blade Cup—there's other people that will. Bad people. Serpentine. And we need it to save the world. I know how ridiculous this sounds, but I'm proud of who I am, and I want you to be proud of me, too.”
— Cole to Lou, "The Royal Blacksmiths"

Lou is Cole's father and a dancer who wanted his son to follow in his footsteps. After Lilly's death, Lou dedicated himself more to his performances, causing their relationship to become strained, and Cole felt he had to become the responsible one in the family. Before Cole was recruited by Wu, Lou sent him to Marty Oppenheimer School of Performing Arts, but he ran away and wouldn't see his father for some time.

After reuniting with his father, Cole was unable to admit that he dropped out and became a ninja. Eventually, Cole revealed his true identity, and Lou was furious at his decision to steal the Blade Cup. He watched Cole battle a few Serpentine and was impressed with his son's heroism. The two reconciled their relationship and became closer, as Lou once made a song to show how proud he was of him.

After Cole and Lou resolved their conflicts, Cole became delighted when he would see his father performing, such as when The Royal Blacksmiths arrived at the Ninjaball Run.

In "Day of the Departed," Lou wondered what was taking Cole so long to meet him, as he was looking forward to lighting lanterns with him for the holiday but Cole couldn't show up because of Yang's actions. They were able to spend time together, by the time of the next holiday.

During The Hands of Time, Cole was surprised to find his father was being held hostage by the Vermillion and with the help of Jay together they freed him and everyone else.

In "Snake Jaguar," after Cole used his singing to annoy a Sons of Garmadon member enough to escape imprisonment, Cole remarked that his father would be proud.

Lilly[]

“Oh Cole, don't you see? I am proud. I want you to promise me, Cole, that you will always stand up to those who are cruel and unjust. Always.”
“I- I promise, Mom. Always.”
— Lilly and Cole, "Dungeon Crawl!"

Lilly was Cole's mother who passed her elemental powers on to her son before her death. During Cole's flashback in "Dungeon Crawl!," he stated that he doesn't want her to be sick anymore. After Lilly learned that Cole was involved in a fight at school, he made a promise to make his mother proud by standing up against anyone who is cruel and unjust.

In "The Jade Princess," he appears to have been close to her as he told Wu that he was sad at her passing and resorted to climbing mountains as a way of coping with her being gone.

During "Into the Dark," Cole tackled a Geckle named Gleck and saw a necklace that includes the pictures of Lou and Lilly inside it.

Students

Students[]

Frak[]

Frak is the Master of Quake and a first Cole's student. They first met at the Tournament of the Sources, where their mutual friend, Arin, was also present. During that time, Frak was mentored by Ras. Frak went against Cole and won, effectively obtaining the latter's power. During his battle with Zur and struggling with the new powers, Cole gave Frak some advice.

Mentors

Mentors[]

Master Wu[]

“Wu would never quit on us, and we're not quitting on him.”
— Cole, "The Mask of Deception"

Cole is Wu's student along with the other ninja. When Cole and the others trained to become ninja, he is shown to care about Wu and glad to have him mentoring them. Cole is the closest to Wu, as he was his first student as a ninja. Following Wu's sacrifice to defeat the Time Twins, Cole and the others were devastated by his loss and made plans to find their lost master. Cole was the most devastated by the loss of his master.

In Season 8: Sons of Garmadon, he is the main one focused on finding his master and has changed some of his habits to be more driven such as giving up on sweets and training more intently.

Cole later encounters a mysterious baby while being held prisoner to the Sons of Garmadon. Cole is responsible for taking care of the baby and at the end of the episode "Dead Man's Squall," Cole is seen shielding the baby to protect it from the Bounty's crash.

In "The Quiet One," it is revealed that the Baby is Wu with Cole being the most surprised as he sees the infant talk and drink tea. Cole questioned this before Nya and Zane came up with a theory for it and how he'll turn back to normal very soon. Despite his shock, Cole was very happy to have his master back.

During the events of Hunted, Cole is primarily the one who tries and teaches Wu in hopes of helping him regain his memories. He and Cole work together to try and save Jay, Kai, and Zane, who had been captured by the Dragon Hunters. When Wu ages into a teenager, Cole, along with the other ninja, are happy to see him age further and does his best to support Wu as he tries to remember his memories, even when the other ninja doubt Wu. When Wu fully regains his memories and ages into an older teenager, Cole is overjoyed as his old master is back.

In "Green Destiny," Cole and Wu return to Ninjago along with the others. They save Lloyd and the others and fight off the Sons of Garmadon and Colossus before Lloyd defeats Garmadon. In the end, Cole sees Wu has returned to being an old man and happy he is finally normal Wu again.

In "Under Siege", Cole was shock to find out that Wu was the Treacherous Deceiver and criticizes his decision teaching Aspheera Spinjitzu and almost causing a war.

Cole's trust in Wu extended to where he didn't believe that he caused The Merge, but was shocked to find out that Ras was telling the truth.

Friends

Friends[]

Jay[]

“I never meant to hurt you, Jay. If I knew it would destroy our friendship, I'd take it all back.”
— Cole to Jay, "Versus"

Cole and Jay were best friends throughout the series. Cole and Jay argued in earlier seasons, and Cole was most likely to be annoyed with him, due to the differing personalities (Cole was always serious and Jay was childish and unfocused), they always have each other's backs like the other ninja.

In Season 3, their friendship hit a rough patch when Nya developed a crush on Cole; this makes Jay upset, and Cole becomes a rival for her affection out of annoyance for Jay; which, along with Zane's "death" to defeat the Overlord serves as the main reason for the team breaking up.

In Season 4, they refuse to be on the same team again and continue fighting with each other about Nya. Jay even notes that he was more upset about losing Cole than Nya, showing the power of their friendship. When Chen forces them to duel in the tournament, the two get out some of their pent-up frustration but in the end, they rekindle their friendship with Cole sacrificing himself so Jay could advance. They maintain their friendship in the next season with Jay expressing sadness (nearly crying) when Cole was turned into a ghost by Yang and attempting to move him out of his despair.

During Season 6, Cole confronted Jay about him keeping his encounters with Nadakhan a secret from him and the others, being angered by his reasons. However, Cole was overjoyed to see Jay and Nya reconcile their relationship, not even upset she chose Jay over him, showing how much they have rebuilt their friendship. Jay considers Cole as his best friend.

In "Day of the Departed," when the ninja rushed to Cole's aid as he was fighting Yang, Cole was re-energized and managed to overpower and defeat the ghostly master. When Cole was thought to be departed, Jay broke down crying and stated that he would give anything to have Cole back, which the latter overheard before revealing himself to be alright. Jay and other ninja were relieved when Cole was okay and became a human again.

They still get along in future seasons, though Cole was put off by Jay going crazy in the Realm of Oni and Dragons until he regained himself.

When seeing Cole fall in the darkness of the Oni, Jay was horrified but along with the others had to reluctantly accept it.

In "Endings," he was relieved to see him return and happily asked him to help fend off the Oni attacking the Monastery.

In "The Turn of the Tide" Nya defeats Wojira by merging with the ocean and leaves. While Cole himself was saddened by Nya's departure, he was aware of how depressed Jay was by this. Cole can be seen silently comforting his friend during Nya's memorial.

A year afterwards, Cole continued to comfort Jay and tried to convince him to come back to the team. After the ninja found a way to bring Nya back, Cole and Jay worked together to infiltrate Borg Tower vaults.

In "Land of Lost Things" Cole was saddened when Nya told him that Jay wasn't found after the Merge.

In "Fugitives From Madness" Cole happily remembers one of the funny times he and Jay got into a fight about a video game that resulted in them making a crack in the wall and ending it with going to Chen's Noodle House. Despite calling Jay a bonehead, Cole felt a pang of nostalgia and missed Jay, wishing he was with them and worried where he ended up after the Merge.

In "Inside the Maze," Cole was shocked to see Jay fighting on Ras's team. After hearing Jay pointed out that he had no idea who Nya was, Cole first spoke up say that " Jay wouldn't forget Nya or any of us." Out of denial, he thought Ras has "a fake Jay or some loser wearing a Jay wig", until Lloyd reminded him that none of them knew what happened to Jay after he disappeared in the Merge. Cole could do nothing as he watch his friend attack Nya and even used a Wolf Mask to shatter his goodness. Cole was even horrified when Jay expressed hatred towards Nya after losing to her. In "United We Fall", Cole and the others went to get Jay back, even threatening Ras about Jay's current state only for Ras to tell them that The Merge did it to him and he already sent Jay away for failing.

In "The Shatter Dragon", Cole reunites with the still amnesiac Jay, who was injured after helping the Ninja defeat Thunderfang. Cole happily greeted Jay but found out that he still doesn't remember them.

Kai[]

“See? There! And Lloyd says we don't focus enough on teamwork.”
— Kai to Cole, "A Pain in the Mech!"

They are good friends throughout the series. Cole and Kai respect each other and both are close friends. He and Kai are both confident, strong, leaders, and brave. Kai and Cole are often shown association with each other, the two like to team together and hang out with each other a lot as shown in the later seasons. As shown in Prime Empire specifically; the two always have each other's backs and would risk their lives for the other, showing just how close the two friends are.

In Season 5, Kai was sad that Cole became a ghost and attempted to cheer him up. Kai made sure Cole never gave up and they even took Morro down together along with Lloyd, with their relationship growing stronger in the end.

In "Day of the Departed," Kai and the others were very happy to see Cole return to being a human.

When seeing Cole fall in the darkness of the Oni, Kai was distraught and immediately tried to save him but was stopped by Zane. He grieves over Cole along with his sister, Nya, later in the episode. This marks the second time that Kai cried on-screen. Kai soon accepted that he had to continue their mission.

In "Endings," Cole returns to his friends, and Kai was relieved to see him back as they fended off the Oni attacking the Monastery.

In "The Cliffs of Hysteria," when Cole was about to fall from his rope and loose his last life, Kai recklessly decided to jump on an Aerial drone, not wanting to see his friend fall again.

In "The Speedway Five-Billion," Kai lets Cole ride on the back of his jet in the race until he steals a Whack Rat's Quad Bike. When they see Jay get surrounded by Red Visors, Cole and Kai both agree to go out with a bang and sacrifice themselves for their teammates.

In "Unsinkable," both Cole and Kai volunteered to stay at the monastery while the rest went to explore the Tartarus Trench, while Kai spent most of the time with his father, the two did work together when fighting Kalmaar and his soldiers during "Riddle of the Sphinx," "Papergirl," and "Master of the Sea."

In "Safe Haven," Kai was able to drag a semi unconscious Cole from the rubble of their vehicles, eventually two with the help of Skylor were able to keep Jake safe and reunited him with his parents.

Long after the Merge, Kai and Cole went on a few missions and adventures together when Cole briefly returned to the monastery, such as stopping a corrupted Lobbo, the Mechanic, Ice Dragons, and Lava-Tides. Kai, Cole and Sora were able to combine different parts of their Elemental Mechs.

In "Elements of Betrayal" Cole was happy to see Kai back as he immediately ran to hug him.

After Lloyd left to look for Arin's parents, Cole and Kai took over Frak's training together, trying to teach him Spinjitzu. After an accidental crash between Frak and Riyu demolished the training course, the three of them went to the Land of Lost Things to continue training Frak. When Frak gets to feel the earth screaming just like Cole, they and Kai team up to find its source, ending up unearthing the remains of the Source Dragon of Balance. While Cole and Frak rose their remains, Kai backed them up by blasting rocks that were in the way.

When Fritz, Spitz and Bonzle have their souls extracted by spectral Draconian Warriors led by Nokt, becoming hollowed, Kai helped Cole in his drive to save them. However, when the latter started to let his emotions cloud his reason, Kai tried to keep him focused on what needed to be done, but without success. Despite wanting to help Cole, Kai knew that he needed to prioritize the update of the Prismatic Blades so they could fight the enemy. When it was done, it was too late, as Cole's soul was absorbed, leaving him hollowed, much to Kai's sadness.

Zane[]

“A ninja doesn't save himself. He protects those who can't protect themselves. I have to go back. I have to go back and save them all.”
“And a ninja never leaves another ninja's side.”
— Cole and Zane, "Spy for a Spy"

Like the others, Cole was put off by Zane's personality but when finding out he was Nindroid, he and the others supported and accepted their friend. In earlier seasons, Cole and Zane were best friends due to them being similar to being serious among the ninja.

When Zane sacrificed himself to defeat the Overlord and was seemingly destroyed, Cole was distraught by his friend's demise and was unable to continue being a ninja.

In season 4, when Lloyd suggested replacing Zane, Cole and the others were adamant about not replacing Zane until they spotted a poster that said he was still alive causing them to enter Chen's fighting tournament to find him. After being eliminated from the tournament, Cole was the first of the ninja to find Zane, being relieved to see him alive and well in a new form and immediately promised to break him out of his captivity. Working together, they manage to break free however, due to Cole's promise of breaking the other elemental masters out of Chen's grasps, he implored Zane to leave while he goes back. To his surprise, Zane decides to help him deeming that ninja never leave one another behind. After a series of plans, they were successful in liberating the captives and joined their allies in defeating Chen.

The two don't have much interaction in Season 5, though Zane comforted Cole after he became a ghost.

In "Day of the Departed," Zane and the others were very happy that Cole was fine and became a human again.

During Season 7, Cole was worried for Zane after he was rendered off-line by the Time Twins. However, he was happy to see that he recovered and ready to help. During Season 9, Cole and Zane worked to survive in the Realm of Oni and Dragons. Cole also worked to free his friends from Iron Baron.

When seeing Cole fall in the darkness of the Oni, Zane was horrified but stopped a distraught Kai from trying to behave recklessly since it was too late to save him. In "Endings," he was relieved to see him return and happily asked him to help fend off the Oni attacking the Monastery.

Cole and the other ninja embarked on a journey to save Zane in "A Cold Goodbye."

During "Awakenings," an encounter with Boreal caused the others to realize Zane was the Ice Emperor. Although hesitant to believe this, Cole realized Zane was corrupted by the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu, which caused him to become a monster. He wanted to free Zane of his trance. Likewise, Zane finally remembers him and a happy moment of them together. He then snaps out of his delirium enough to help his friends.

Following the Liberation of Imperium, Cole returned from the Land of Lost Things to Ninjago and warned Zane about the wolf warriors who were after Bonzle. Together, they managed to defeat two of the Wolf Mask Claw Warriors that had passed through the portal gate and sent them back to the Land of Lost Things. Later, Zane informed Cole that the wolf warriors had sent Ras to hunt down Bonzle. As Cole and Zane delved deeper into Bonzle's story and the reason why Ras wanted her for the Ritual of the Blood Moon, they set off on a journey to Mysterium in search of Gandalaria. However, they were intercepted by Dorama before they could successfully defeat him alongside Bonzle. The group eventually found Gandalaria, where Cole requested Bonzle's protection. Following their victory against the Administration Agents, they proceeded to search for the magical storage-house under Bonzle's watch. However, their attempts were futile as Jordana captured Bonzle and imprisoned Cole, Zane, and Gandalaria in an electro cage. During their quest for Bonzle, they managed to rescue the Cloud Kingdom and the Cloud Monks from destruction.

Nya[]

“Cole loved you like a brother. I mean, a sister.”
— Kai to Nya, "The Fall"

Cole and Nya are good friends throughout the series, but in Season 3, Nya developed a crush on Cole, which caused him a rivalry between him and Jay, due to Jay finding out that Cole was Nya's perfect match. Cole originally saw Nya as a friend and ignored her, due to his uptight and serious personality. Cole was confused by the Nya attention gave him, so he briefly appeared to reciprocate,[1] and doubles down to get back at Jay for being irrationally angry at him.

In Season 5, when Cole became a ghost, she supported the depressed Cole to keep on trying with his life and never give up.[2] It's worth noting that Cole and Nya's friendship did not make Nya immune to criticism in Cole's eyes, as Cole became harsh with her for a moment after Ronin stole the Sword of Sanctuary.[3]

In Season 6, Nya ultimately chooses to be with Jay but Cole is supportive of her choice with all three remaining good friends in the end.

In "Day of the Departed," Nya and the others were very happy Cole was fine and became a human again.

During Season 7, they continue to be good comrades when facing Time Twins.

During "The Fall," when learning that Cole fell in the darkness, Nya was horrified and along with the others broke down, due to being indirectly responsible.

In "Endings," she was relieved to see him return and gave him his scythe to help him fend off the Oni attacking the Monastery. When Jay asks Nya to be his Yang, he is initially critical of Jay's timing but is ultimately happy for his friends.

In "The Turn of the Tide", Cole became saddened by the sacrifice Nya made to save Ninjago and was later seen comforting Jay at her memorial.

In "Farewell the Sea", Cole is the only one to not give in to his grief over Nya's sacrifice, being the only Ninja to not give in on the job or suprass his own emotions. According to him, he is just doing what Nya had wanted them to do: to keep fighting.

Lloyd[]

When they first met, Cole thought Lloyd was troublesome and would tell Master Wu to give him a severe punishment in "Never Trust a Snake." After he reformed, they bonded and became good friends to the point, that the former would prank him more often than the other ninja.

Lloyd and Cole continue to be good friends throughout the series, with Cole giving Lloyd support which would inspire him to keep trying whenever Lloyd was feeling down in some battles against their enemies. When Lloyd was possessed by Morro, he and the other ninja did everything they could to rescue him from the Ghost Warriors. After saving him, Lloyd says Ninjago is at risk of being in possession because of the Preeminent, but the Earth Ninja tells him they won't be able to stop her without him.

Overall, Lloyd looks up to Cole and they work together greatly as they are both the strongest ninja on the team. In Season 6, they worked together throughout the season. Both of them even sacrificed themselves for Jay and Nya to getaway. They have other's backs and both led their friends against the Sky Pirates.

In "Day of the Departed," Lloyd and the other ninja were glad to see that Cole was okay and became a human again.

In Season 7, Cole supported Lloyd throughout the season. One point, Cole and Kai went against Lloyd's orders so that they could take action. At the end of the season, Cole and the others let Lloyd take charge during Wu's absence. During Season 8, Cole made fun of Lloyd's crush on Harumi and the latter was surprised at Cole's singing. Other than that, they get along as Cole respected Lloyd's leadership and followed his orders as they worked together. Cole was also worried for Lloyd after Harumi's true colors were revealed and he didn't hesitate to try and give up his powers to heal Lloyd after he fought Garmadon.

For most of Season 9, Cole was mostly in the Realm of Oni and Dragons and worried for Lloyd and the others. In "Green Destiny," Cole was reunited with his friend and they saved Ninjago from Garmadon and Cole was happy Lloyd's power returned.

In "Endings," he was relieved to see him return and the two friends fend off the Oni attacking the Monastery.

In "Farewell the Sea," Cole and Kai tried to convince Lloyd to rejoin the team after Nya's sacrifice, an offer Lloyd initially declined by lashing out at him. After Lloyd regrouped with the team, he began to show his frustrations revolving the New Ninja's existence. After he screamed at Zane, Cole was able to calm Lloyd out.

After the Merge, Cole was separated from Lloyd and the other ninja, years afterwards, Lloyd found a memorial of the other ninja, including Cole at the Crossroads Carnival.

While the two were both present in the monastery during "A Pain in the Mech!," Lloyd and Cole shared a hug together in "Rising Ninja."

Arin[]

Arin is Lloyd's student. He first met Cole off-screen, and later when Cole returned to the monastery upon discovering the presence of dangerous artificats in Kreel's Junkyard.

Towards the end of the Tournament of the Sources, they both went to the Monastery of Gates together, where they leart from the spirit of Wu that he was responsible for the Merge. Cole refused to believe while Arin, already influced by Ras, did. After Arin betrayed the ninja to join Ras to find his parents, Cole showed concern for Arin due to the portal gate blowing up.

Sora[]

“Someone's done her homework on me.”
“My best friend's a ninja super fan. He even got a Zane haircut once.”
“Please tell me you're kidding.”
“I wish I was.”
— Cole and Sora, "Land of Lost Things"

Sora is one of Lloyd's ninja students. and currently, Lloyd’s only student. He first met her, thinking she, Nya, and Riyu were going to harm Fritz and Spitz until he recognized Nya and stood down. After their failed attempt at preventing Dr. LaRow from taking the Yellow Dragon Core, Cole decided not to accompany her and Nya in order to search for Wu. They meet again when Cole returned to the monastery upon discovering many dangerous artefacts including Chronosteel, were brought to Kreel's junkyard. During the Noodle cook-off, Sora was initially angry at Cole for bringing outside noodles there, but later shared and enjoyed a bowl of mixed noodles with him.

Wyldfyre[]

“Wyldfyre, your anger is not helping.”
“It's helping me stay angry!”
— Cole and Wyldfyre, "Truth and Lies"

Cole is Wyldfyre's teammate. They had little interaction, besides Cole trying to calm her down when Nokt insulted Nya's brother Kai and her boyfriend Jay only for Wyldfyre to cause him look annoyed. Even during Nya's fight, Cole tried to help calm her down.

Geo[]

“I was too scared to tell you. I... thought you would leave if you didn't need me.”
“But I do need you. If my new form has been part of my elemental power all along, I clearly needed you to help me realize my true potential.”
— Geo and Cole, "Land of Lost Things"

Geo and Cole are very close, and have built a family in the Finders. They met sometime after the Merge. Cole woke up in the Land of Lost Things, where Geo, a Munce with Geckle coloring, was banished with a few kids from other realms. In the years following the Merge, Cole told Geo about his adventures he had in the past and the locations he visited, such as the Cloud Kingdom and about his friends such as Jay. After gaining the ability to transform into a golem, Cole assumed it was a combination of Geo and his own's Elemental Powers, until Geo revealed that it was Cole's own power. He was afraid Cole would leave if he knew the truth, but Cole reassured him he would not, as him helping further unlock his potential showed that he did still need him as part of his life.

Before Cole returns, Geo fondly looks at a picture of himself, Cole, and the other Finders. He reminisces about moments he and Cole had together in "The Land of Lost Things"; when Cole comes back to them after the fight and holds hands with him, and when he catches Geo on his dragon.

Geo and Cole reunite in "Inside the Maze" where the two have a good time exploring the city together. Geo even brings Cole to an Earth Mech in excitement.

Chris "Doc" Wyatt has alluded to Geode, the fandom-given name for a potential romantic relationship between Cole and Geo.[4] He has also liked tweets in support of it being canon. Writer of Geo's debut episode Glen Lakin also supports the relationship, though "cannot comment on what is/isn't canon."[5] In response to a fan asking if they will kiss at the 2024 San Diego Comic-Con panel, someone on the team responded, "keep watching."[6]

Bonzle[]

“I'm so proud of her. She was. . . such a selfless little spell.”
“No, she was a selfless person.”
— Gandalaria and Cole, "Rising Ninja"

Bonzle is one of the Finders that Cole befriended when he ended up there after the Merge. Cole and Geo became guardians to her and the other kids, though she technically existed for thousands for years before choosing her current form. When Bonzle mentioned she was a spell that took in her current form and was worried about what others would think, Cole was one of many to comfort her and, along with Zane, accompanied her to Mysterium to meet her creator, Gandalaria. After Bonzle was reverted back to her spell form to try and summon the Forbidden Five, managing to close the portal to the Nether-Space, Cole was saddened upon hearing it, even telling Gandalaria that Bonzle was 'a selfless person.'

Fritz & Spitz[]

This section is a stub. You can help expand this section by adding some information.


Vania[]

“You don't need me. You're one of the strongest and bravest people I've ever met.”
— Cole, "The Son of Lilly"

Cole got along well with Vania.

In their first meeting, she was excited to finally meet him in person. Cole was warned by a worried Lloyd that she could be untrustworthy, due to his own experience. Cole assures Lloyd that he didn’t feel that way about her.

During "Into the Dark," Vania has shown most of her interest in Cole, something he seems touched by. When the ninja didn't believe his story, Vania states that she believes his story as she has seen a Geckle before.

She was under the impression that he was the leader of the ninja until Wu said otherwise.

In "The Skull Sorcerer," Vangelis is revealed to be the enemy, Vania made the decision to side with Cole and the ninja against her father.

She travels with Cole and Wu, through the tunnel where they work together to escape the Dungeons of Shintaro.

During "The Son of Lilly," Vania helps Cole in saving his friends and sees him defeat her father. With her father arrested and his crimes exposed, Vania becomes the new queen. When the ninja were preparing to leave Shintaro, Vania shares the moment with Cole, and both promise to work with each other in the future.

More than a year later, Cole was able to contact her, allowing her to fulfil her promise to bring her army to help Cole during the final prophecy of Quanish the Elder.

Gandalaria[]

Gandalaria is Bonzle's creator. While they haven't personally interacted yet, they both want to ensure Bonzle's happiness and safety and have worked together in trying to save Bonzle and the Cloud Kingdom.

Seliel[]

Seliel and Cole are good friends in the book Who is the Phantom Ninja? and in the novel Way of the Departed. While this relationship is only shown in books that are considered "could-be-canon"[7], this means that Seliel and her friendship with Cole isn't mentioned or acknowledged in the main shows.

Karlof[]

They did not truly interact until after both lost their matches.

While working in Chen's factory, Karlof tried to dissuade Cole from any attempts at escape especially when they saw Jacob Pevsner taken away. However, Karlof covered for him when Cole found his captive friend Zane and regain hope. Once Cole voiced his intent of escape, Karlof was somewhat moved and asked Cole to break him out and the Earth Ninja hastily promised. In the end, Cole kept his promise with him, and Zane returning to liberate all Chen's captives. They do work together and regained their lost power and fought Chen.

During Hands of Time, Cole once more encounters Karlof who was captured. Cole and Jay save him from the Time Twins and the Vermillion.

Krag[]

“Friends?”
— Cole to Krag, "Krag's Lament"

Cole encountered Krag when journeying for the Traveler's Tree. Their first meeting wasn’t off to a good start. Cole immediately attacked the Yeti when he believed it was trying to harm him (in truth trying to save him from a fall). Despite Cole’s actions, the Yeti was still compassionate enough to provide him with food and shelter. Eventually, Cole found out it was the last of his kind and decided to befriend him. Cole also stopped Jay and Nya from attacking Krag and asked if he wanted to join them down the mountain, to which he accepted.

During "Once and for All," Cole and Krag are shown to be able to communicate as Krag complied with his order of stopping with his games.

In "Awakenings," as the ninja had to go home, Cole found it hard to part with Krag who gave Cole one more tight hug before he left, and was saddened before being comforted by Sorla. Cole took one last glance at his friend before heading home.

Enemies

Enemies[]

Yang (formerly)[]

“Not to a ghost. Which thanks to you, I still am!”
— Cole to Yang, "Day of the Departed"

On "The Temple on Haunted Hill," Cole and his allies entered to Master Yang's Temple of Airjitzu. As the ninja hurried to get out of the temple before sunrise, Cole accidentally dropped the Scroll of Airjitzu, causing Yang to turn him into a ghost. His transformation became the reason that Cole wanted revenge on the Airjitzu master.

During "Day of the Departed," they meet again when Yang confronts Cole through a painting, telling him to "close the circle." Desiring revenge for being made a ghost, Cole proceeds to steal the Yin Blade and head to Yang's Temple to settle the score, where he meets Yang. Unbeknownst to him, this was Yang's plan and feigning fear, he tricks Cole into attacking him. This allows the ghosts of the ninja's foes to escape the Departed Realm. Yang has his students capture Cole and lock him up, where he mocks Cole on dooming his friends since the ghosts will distract the separated remaining ninja. allowing the ghostly master opens a Rift to the Departed Realm and become mortal again. Cole ultimately escapes and fights Yang for a while until the corrupt master overpowers him and proceeds to demoralize him calling him a ghost who will be forgotten and who will take his place as Master of the house. However, the voices of the ninja who have defeated their villains, reenergize Cole who rises to face off against Yang again.

This time in their fight, Cole unleashes enough power to shatter the Yin Blade and freeing Yang's students of his control. As the Rift begins to close, the formerly imprisoned pupils are prompted by Cole to go through the Rift, allowing them to become mortal while Yang admits defeat. Bitter, Yang reveals he wanted to be immortal so he would not be forgotten and Cole reminds him as the creator of Airjitzu that he would not be forgotten by anyone. Cole then flies the two of them towards the Rift but Yang tells him one of them must remain behind as the Temple's master because of the curse, and throws Cole into the disappearing Rift claiming he wanted to settle his "debts." Afterward, Cole becomes human again and he and the ninja move into the Temple, while Yang wanders the halls, no longer a sadistic monster but a kind master who has accepted his fate, with only Cole being aware of his presence.

Vangelis[]

“I don't know what's going on here. But I know a bad guy when I see one! And that, is a bad guy.”
— Cole, "Into the Dark"

Cole met him when he and Vania discovered the Skull Keep.

Cole attempted to fight him but the Vengestone around the area prevented him from using his powers and left him at a disadvantage, leading to him being taken captive. When the ninja, Geckles, and Munce escaped from him, Vangelis targeted Cole with his attacks and chased him down, but lost him through the tunnels.

In "The Skull Sorcerer," he reported to Vangelis about this but was shocked to learn that he was really the Skull Sorcerer. Cole and Wu were then sent to a trap and fell through a tunnel.

During "The Upply Strike Back!," Cole spots him threatening his friends. Cole then confronts the villain, who is annoyed to see him again.

In "The Son of Lilly," Cole uses his mother's weapons against the Skull Sorcerer. An intense battle ensues between the pair, despite putting up a good fight, the Earth Ninja is overwhelmed. The Skull Sorcerer then starts to mock him and his mother but this only goes to inspires Cole to unlocks the ability to use the Spinjitzu Burst. Cole then defeats the Skull Sorcerer by destroying the source of his power and leaving him defenseless. In awe by his acts, Vangelis concedes and begs for mercy. Due to Cole's actions, Vangelis is stripped from the throne and succeeded by his daughter.

A year later, Cole was annoyed to be reunited with the former King who sought revenge. Using the latter's crystalized Scythe of Quakes, Vangelis claims that what had happened to him were lies before Cole reclaimed the Scythe and used it to trap Vangelis.

Ras (temporary ally)[]

“Whatever you've done to him.”
“Me? The Merge left Jay Walker without his memory. Lost, alone, friendless. I found him. Helped him where no one else did. Where were you?”
— Cole and Ras, "United We Fall"

Ras is one of Cole's enemies. Ras had went after one of Cole's friends Bonzle and Bonzle was almost lost to the Nether-Space as a result. During the Tournament of the Sources, Cole agreed with Arin about Ras being the one taking the dragon horns. Cole's resentment of Ras grew when he saw Ras use the Gong of Shattering to shatter Jay's goodness. In "United We Fall", Cole was the one who threatened Ras only for Ras to tell him that he did nothing to Jay and already sent Jay away for failing. In "The Final Game", Cole assumed Ras was lying about Wu causing The Merge, which he was shocked to find out he was telling the truth.

Nokt[]

Cole first encountered Nokt during the Tournament of the Sources, where the latter planned to seize the Elemental Powers to liberate the remaining members of the Forbidden Five. Subsequently, during the spectral invasions, Nokt successfully captured the souls of the Finders, excluding Geo. In an attempt to rescue their souls, Cole confronted Nokt; however, his arrogance hindered his efforts, ultimately leading to his own hollowing.
